Experience with React.js is a plus. * Hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and maintaining APIs, as well as integrating with third\-party APIs or platforms. * Solid understanding of security concepts and practices, with experience in a cybersecurity domain is a plus, but not strictly required * Strong communication skills and a practical, outcome\-oriented approach to problem solving. #### **Compensation** Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $160,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $230,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job\-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed. #### **Perks** * 100% medical, dental and vision coverage * Flexible PTO policy * Annual home office stipend and WeWork access * Mental \& physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)! * Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement #### **Why Coalition?** Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote\-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition's exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real\-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion. We're always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join \#OurCoalition. Visit our Newsroom \> #### **Privacy Notice** Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled. Our Privacy Policy \> #### **Safe Hiring Notice** All legitimate communication from Coalition comes from @coalitioninc.com emails, and open roles are listed only on our Careers page. We never ask for payment, banking details, or personal identification before an offer is accepted through our secure systems. If you believe you've been a victim of fraudulent recruiting, follow guidance from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). #### **Anti\-Discrimination Notice** Coalition is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable laws in each country where we operate. This commitment includes, but is not limited to, ensuring equal treatment in recruitment, selection, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, and all other aspects of employment. Coalition does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. #### **Accommodations** Coalition is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, including applicants and employees, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in each country where we operate. Our policy is to support equal opportunity in the hiring process by considering qualified applicants regardless of disability or other protected characteristics, unless providing accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden. If you require accommodation to complete an application, interview, pre\-employment testing, or participate in the selection process, please contact us at candidateaccommodations@coalitioninc.com. We also consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in line with applicable laws and regulations in each jurisdiction. **To all recruitment agencies:** Coalition does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our email alias, employees, or other physical or virtual organization locations. Coalition is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer- Englewood, CO or Sunnyvale, CA- ONSITE 4X Weely- FreeWheel
jobs.description: FreeWheel, a Comcast company, provides comprehensive ad platforms for publishers, advertisers, and media buyers. Powered by premium video content, robust data, and advanced technology, we’re making it easier for buyers and sellers to transact across all screens, data types, and sales channels. As a global company, we have offices in nine countries and can insert advertisements around the world. **Job Summary** FreeWheel is seeking a Lead Software Engineer (ENG 5\) to serve as a principal\-level individual contributor driving the technical direction of our Buyer Cloud Ad Serving platform. The Ad Serving system is the high\-throughput backbone of FreeWheel's demand\-side platform (DSP). jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer, Commure Pro
jobs.description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** ------------------ As a **Senior Fullstack Engineer**, you'll be critical to designing, developing, and supporting both backend and frontend logic for our innovative healthcare AI applications. You'll be instrumental in building scalable, robust, and reliable systems that empower healthcare providers to deliver better patient care. You’ll thrive in our collaborative team environment, where your innovative ideas are valued and you’re challenged to create elegant solutions to complex problems. You will actively participate in the design and development of new features and contribute to the ongoing evolution of our architecture. You'll quickly grasp complex concepts and leverage your extensive experience to identify areas for improvement and drive impactful change. ***This role is a remote full time position and can be based anywhere in the US.*** **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design and Develop: Build and maintain scalable, healthcare AI applications using Java and React. * Architect Solutions: Design robust, performant, and maintainable system architectures, focusing on cloud application best practices. * Collaborate: Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into effective solutions. * Optimize Performance: Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks to ensure high application availability and efficiency. * Innovate: Contribute to the development of cutting\-edge features leveraging the power of AI and machine learning. * Code Review: Participate in code reviews to foster knowledge sharing and best practices across the team. * Maintain Quality: Write thorough tests and documentation to ensure code quality and maintainability. * Deployment and Support: Assist with the development, deployment, and support of on\-prem and cloud\-based solutions, spanning from internal development to customer production systems. **What You Have** ----------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent extensive experience * Professional software development experience with a focus on full\-stack development, including backend APIs, frontend UI, system integrations, and user authentication. * Deep expertise in Java programming, including experience designing and implementing highly optimized and scalable architectures. * Experience with building enterprise\-grade full\-stack applications using Spring Boot, React, UX design frameworks, and relational and document databases. * Proven experience in developing and deploying cloud\-based applications (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP). * Solid understanding of RESTful API design principles and experience building and consuming REST APIs. * Strong experience with relational databases, including Oracle, PostgreSQL, and document databases, including MongoDB and derivatives. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Bonus points for: + Experience in the healthcare domain, including HL7 and FHIR. + Experience with AI/ML concepts and frameworks. + Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks. + Working knowledge of containers (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes). Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization. Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis. Compensation Range: $160K \- $230K

jobs.title: Assistant Teaching Professor Position in Biomedical Engineering, Cornell University (Ithaca, NY)
jobs.description: The Nancy E. and Peter C. Meinig School of Biomedical Engineering at Cornell University has a full\-time position for an Assistant Teaching Professor to teach and develop undergraduate and master’s level biomedical engineering courses. Teaching Professors are non\-tenure track teaching faculty members who are hired on multi\-year appointments with the expectation of renewal and promotion, with a 9\-month service period plus summer opportunities. This position has an anticipated start date of Fall 2027\. Teaching Professors in the Meinig School teach two 3\-credit hour courses per semester and participate in faculty meetings, curricular review committees, and strategic planning. The Meinig School is conducting two parallel faculty searches in biomedical engineering education. This Teaching Professor position is intended for educators who will provide leadership in undergraduate education through excellence and innovation in teaching, curriculum development, and student mentoring and advising; candidates will be evaluated primarily on the strength and potential of their teaching, educational leadership, and contributions to the biomedical engineering curriculum. In contrast, the school’s tenure\-track discipline\-based engineering education research (DBER) position is intended for scholars who will establish an independent, nationally recognized education research program, including mentoring Ph.D. students and postdoctoral scholars and advancing the field through innovative scholarship, external funding, and national leadership; candidates for that position will be evaluated on the strength and potential of their DBER scholarship. A Ph.D. in bioengineering/biomedical engineering or closely related field is preferred with a record of outstanding teaching experience beyond the graduate teaching assistant level. Teaching experience aligned with one or more concentration areas within the biomedical engineering curriculum is expected, including but not limited to biomechanics, biomaterials, biomedical imaging, and cellular systems and computational biology. Preference will be given to candidates with expertise in Machine Learning and/or Artificial Intelligence as applied to biomedical engineering. A strong commitment to undergraduate teaching and advising is essential. Teaching responsibilities will include participation in and development of both undergraduate and masters courses, and strong engagement in the biomedical engineering curriculum. Starting salary and title will depend upon the level of experience of the candidate. The Meinig School of Biomedical Engineering is located in the College ofDuffield Engineering on Cornell’s main campus in Ithaca, New York. Cornell University is an innovative Ivy League university and a great place to work. Our community of scholars, students, and staff contribute creative ideas to further the university’s mission of teaching, discovery and engagement. The main campus sits at the southern tip of Cayuga Lake in the Finger Lakes region of New York State. The Ithaca area offers a small city lifestyle with the cultural and culinary offerings of larger metropolitan areas and outstanding public schools. The climate of the region provides for a range of outdoor activities, including boating/sailing, swimming, mountain biking, and hiking in summer, to skiing and ice skating in winter. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: What We Need Corpay is currently looking to hire an Site Reliability Engineer within our Prepaid card division. A major focus will be reducing manual work, improving deployment and recovery processes, strengthening observability, and increasing automation across Corpay managed and vendor\-provided technology. Just as importantly, this role will help influence how engineering teams design and operate systems by promoting robust, scalable, automated choices rather than relying on manual operational processes. As Corpay becomes an AI\-native software engineering organization, this engineer will leverage AI to accelerate troubleshooting, automation, incident analysis, documentation, and delivery while applying strong engineering judgment. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality & Automation
jobs.description: Crum \& Forster Company Overview: Travel Insured International (TII), a Crum \& Forster company, is hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality \& Automation. Travel Insured International is a leading travel insurance provider with more than 30 years in business. As a key component of our Specialty Business Unit, within the Accident \& Health division, TII provides travel protection plans to help each individual travel confidently. Travel Insured International is proud to offer products to consumers and to agency partners of all sizes. We're committed to providing dependable coverage, great value, and end\-to\-end satisfaction for all customers. Job Description: This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on quality—often referred to in the industry as an SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test). This role writes code to test software: rather than executing test cases manually, you build the automation frameworks, tools, and test infrastructure that verify quality at scale, blending deep software development skills with a quality\-first mindset. You will own TII's test strategy and automation platform as a senior individual contributor. The mission is to transform a largely manual testing practice into an AI\-accelerated, CI/CD\-integrated automation capability—eliminating any regression bottleneck that slows releases, while elevating quality across our Agile Release Trains. We welcome candidates from either a software engineering or quality engineering background. Whether you're a talented full\-stack engineer with an automation\-first mindset or a quality engineer who codes, what matters most is strong hands\-on engineering, the ability to build scalable frameworks, and a genuine passion for shipping high\-quality software. This is a build\-it\-yourself role: you will design and code scalable automation frameworks, integrate testing into Azure DevOps pipelines, introduce AI\-assisted test generation and predictive quality analytics, and uplift the standards and output of a distributed employee/offshore testing team. You will own quality strategy and the automation platform while partnering with engineering and product leadership—embedding quality earlier (shift\-left) and making it a shared, measurable engineering discipline in support of TII's growth target and expansion into new distribution channels. **What you will do:** **Quality Strategy** * Own and evolve TII's test strategy, quality standards, and risk\-based testing approach across the Agile Release Trains. * Define shift\-left quality practices that embed testing into design and development. * Establish release quality gates and standards in partnership with engineering and product leadership. * Lead root cause analysis to systematically minimize production defects. * Ensure adherence to relevant industry standards (ISTQB, ISO) and regulatory/compliance needs in a regulated insurance environment. **Test Automation \& Engineering** * Design, build, and own the automation platform—web (Cypress/Playwright or comparable), mobile, API (GraphQL/REST via Postman), and regression—integrated into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines. * Architect reusable, scalable, and maintainable automation components and frameworks, including data\-driven and keyword\-driven designs. * Drive the conversion of manual testing to automated, continuous testing, systematically increasing regression coverage. * Establish API/contract testing for GraphQL and REST services and validate service integrations. * Introduce performance/load and security testing aligned to the platform's scale and resilience goals. * Own test data management, including compliant synthetic test data for PII\-sensitive scenarios. **Quality Engineering Excellence** * Champion quality as a shared engineering responsibility—embedding testability standards into how software is designed and built. * Partner with engineering architecture to align testing with architectural standards and DevSecOps practices. * Define and make visible quality metrics—escaped\-defect rate, automated coverage, test flakiness, and cycle\-time impact—through reporting and dashboards. * Drive measurable reduction of the regression bottleneck. **Release \& Delivery Quality** * Provide quality signals and gate recommendations into the release process. * Ensure regression and critical\-path coverage give teams the confidence to release faster. * Oversee functional, regression, performance, security, and UAT testing across web, mobile, API, and data layers. **Leadership within the Team** * Co\-lead a small group of quality engineers, manual testers, and off shore test engineers. * Uplift and direct the distributed employee/offshore testing team—raising automation skills and standards, and converting manual capacity toward automation. * Mentor engineers and testers, demonstrating the leadership behaviors that support growth into a formal QE leadership role. * Establish onboarding, standards, and ways of working that scale across distribut including data\-driven and keyword\-driven automation designs. * Hands\-on API development or testing for GraphQL and REST (e.g., Postman) and validation of service integrations. * Proven experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions/Jenkins comparable). * Understanding of test strategy, risk\-based testing, and shift\-left practices in an Agile/Scrum environment. * Experience with cloud environments (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP comparable). * Exposure to AI\-driven engineering or testing tools and methodologies. * Proven leadership or mentoring of distributed/offshore teams required. Formal people\-leadership experience a plus * ISTQB Advanced Level certification or equivalent (for quality\-background candidates) preferred. * Hands\-on experience developing automation or application code using GitHub Copilot or comparable AI\-assisted tooling preferred. * Experience with AI\-assisted test generation and/or predictive quality analytics preferred. * Performance/load testing (e.g., k6, JMeter) and API contract testing (e.g., Pact) preferred. * Test data management / synthetic data experience in a regulated (PII) environment preferred. * Full\-stack development experience (React/Angular, .NET Core, SQL/NoSQL) preferred. * Experience in insurance, travel, fintech, or SaaS preferred. What C\&F will bring to you: **What C\&F will bring to YOU:** * Competitive compensation package * Generous 401K employer match * Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching * Generous Paid Time Off * Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental \& vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing * A core C\&F tenant is owning your career development so we provide a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, including tuition reimbursement, industry related certifications and professional training to keep you progressing on your chosen path * A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment * We believe you do well by doing good and want to encourage a spirit of social and community responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee driven corporate giving program that lets you participate and support your community **At C\&F you will BELONG** We value inclusivity and diversity. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you require a special accommodation, please let us know. For California Residents Only: Information collected and processed as part of your career profile and any job applications you choose to submit are subject to our privacy notices and policies, visit https://www.cfins.com/onlineprivacypolicy/ca/noticeatcollection/ for more information. Crum \& Forster is committed to ensuring a workplace free from discriminatory pay disparities and complying with applicable pay equity laws. Salary ranges are available for all positions at this location, taking into account roles with a comparable level of responsibility and impact in the relevant labor market and these salary ranges are regularly reviewed and adjusted in accordance with prevailing market conditions. jobs.description: Overview: **Our Culture and Impact** Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection. Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. **AI at Cvent: Leading the Future** Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you. **Role Overview** Cvent is accelerating its Salesforce and Agentforce investment, and we need a practitioner who has been there before. This Forward Deployment Engineer will lead Agentforce and Data Cloud deployments, own the shift from traditional CRM automation to production agentic AI, and serve as our senior technical advisor on the Salesforce platform. You have lived the Agentforce delivery lifecycle, built sustainable operating models around it, and know what it takes to make probabilistic AI systems run reliably in a regulated, enterprise environment. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company** The energy industry is entering one of the most significant periods of growth and transformation in its history. Meeting the nation's growing demand for reliable electricity will require new ideas, new infrastructure, and talented people committed to building for the future. At Cypress Creek Energy, we're meeting that challenge by developing and operating the energy infrastructure needed to power communities, support economic opportunity, and strengthen resilience. We believe our responsibility extends beyond the grid and that how we build matters just as much as what we build. That same commitment extends to our employees. We invest in professional growth, encourage collaboration across teams, and provide opportunities to take ownership, expand your expertise, and advance your career. Our culture is grounded in safety, accountability, respect, and a shared commitment to deliver results. Join us and help meet one of the most important energy challenges of our time while building a rewarding career. **Overview** The Software Engineer is responsible for building and maintaining the backend services and APIs that Cypress Creek Energy's business runs on, and for applying machine learning and data science techniques to the forecasting and analytical challenges the business depends on. The role spans the full lifecycle: gathering requirements from business stakeholders, designing and implementing backend services and models, shipping them through the deployment pipeline, and supporting them in production. This role pairs deep backend software engineering with applied machine learning. The majority of the work is designing, building, and maintaining well\-tested APIs and services; that work is complemented by developing and deploying ML models that improve forecasting and data\-driven decision\-making across the business. Engineers build technical depth in the systems and models they own while expanding their domain knowledge of the renewable energy business those systems serve. **Responsibilities** Software Design \& Development * Design, build, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and internal applications. * Write clear, well\-tested, maintainable code and participate actively in code review. * Translate business requirements into technical designs. * Contribute to the team's engineering standards, shared libraries, and services. * Experience with event\-driven or stream\-processing architectures (Kafka or similar). Production Ownership * Deploy and operate services in production including monitoring and triage of failures. * Diagnose issues across service boundaries (application code, data stores, message streams, and third\-party dependencies) and resolve root causes. * Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment configuration for the services you work on. Data, ML \& Integrations * Apply machine learning and statistical modeling techniques to forecasting models and other data science initiatives across the business. * Build and maintain integrations between internal applications and enterprise systems. * Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and model validation using scientific Python tooling (numpy, pandas, and related libraries). * Design and evolve data models in the company's analytical data platform and write efficient queries against large datasets. * Build and maintain data pipelines and services that ingest, transform, and serve data from internal and third\-party sources. * Move ML models from prototype to production: package, deploy, monitor, and retrain models as part of the services you own. Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Partner directly with business users (development, engineering, finance, and operations) to understand their workflows and turn ambiguous needs into working software. * Support internal users of the applications you own, including troubleshooting unexpected results and explaining technical behavior to non\-technical audiences. * Produce and maintain documentation that lets business users work independently and allows other engineers to pick up your work. Continuous Improvement * Identify and address technical debt, manual processes, and operational pain points in the systems you work on. * Evaluate new tools, libraries, and approaches, and make the case for adoption where they meaningfully improve the team's output. * Contribute to a culture of clear documentation, code quality, and engineering discipline across the team. **Education \& Experience Required** * 3\-6 years of professional software engineering experience with backend development in Python. * Experience designing, building, and consuming APIs. * Experience applying machine learning or statistical modeling techniques (for example, forecasting, predictive modeling, or other data science methods). * Experience with scientific or numerical Python (numpy, pandas, and related tooling). * Experience with databases, including schema design, migrations, and query performance. * Background in renewable energy development and/or operations \- solar development, energy modeling, performance engineering, or asset management. * Demonstrated ownership of software in production, including debugging and resolving live issues. * Strong written communication skills; able to document technical work and explain it clearly to non\-technical audiences. * Judgment to distinguish problems that warrant a robust engineered solution from those that need a fast, correct answer today. * Ability to manage ambiguity and drive work to completion with limited direction Preferred Qualifications * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container orchestration (Kubernetes). * Working knowledge of containers and CI/CD. * Experience integrating with Salesforce or a comparable enterprise system of record. * Familiarity with energy modeling. * Experience with ML frameworks and libraries (for example, scikit\-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow) or time\-series forecasting methods. * Embrace and live by the mission and values of Cypress Creek Energy. **Location:** The location for this role is one of our office locations: Durham, NC; or Washington, DC. Our team operates on a hybrid schedule, with in\-office schedule of three days per week. **Compensation:** The salary range for the position is$120,000 \- $150,000**.** This position is also eligible for an annual bonus. Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. **Benefits:** * 15 days of Paid Time Off, accrual up to 20 days, 11 observed holidays. * 401(k) Match * Comprehensive package including medical, dental, vision and health insurance * Wellness stipend, family planning stipend, and generous parental leave * Tuition Reimbursement * Phone Bill Reimbursement * Company Swag **A note to Recruiting Agencies Cypress Creek Energy Human Resources team does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies. The Human Resources team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. We do not accept resumes from third\-party recruiters unless authorized by the Human Resources team and if a signed agreement is in place. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered property of CCE and we are not responsible for any related fees. All communication related to recruiting partnerships should ONLY be directed to the Human Resources team.** **Cypress Creek Energy is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace that is inclusive and values diversity, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.** *Please be aware of recruiting scams—official communications will only come from @ccrenew.com, we will never request personal or financial information, and any suspicious activity should be reported to* *HR@ccrenew.com**.*

jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer, Scientific Discovery
jobs.description: * New York, New York, United States **Location:** New York, NY **Work Model:** Hybrid **Compensation:** $250K to $600K base, plus sign\-on and year\-end bonuses **Overview** A well\-established scientific research organization is standing up a new AI initiative at the intersection of agentic systems, generative AI, scientific computing, and drug discovery. The work is greenfield: rather than maintaining mature systems, the role will help define how AI agents, retrieval systems, and intelligent workflows are built and deployed for researchers working on hard problems in molecular science. The position is a software engineering role first. It calls for someone who has built complex production systems and now wants to apply that ability to LLM applications, RAG architectures, and AI\-assisted research tooling used directly by accomplished scientists and ML researchers. The role carries end\-to\-end ownership, from initial experimentation and prototyping through production\-scale deployment. The environment rewards technical depth and curiosity. The strongest candidates will be comfortable learning unfamiliar scientific domains quickly and translating emerging AI capabilities into reliable software that measurably increases researcher productivity. **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and deploy AI agents, retrieval systems, and RAG architectures that serve as everyday research tools * Take ambitious ideas from ambiguous concept through prototype and into production at scale * Build AI\-powered systems that accelerate computational drug discovery and researcher workflows * Develop data pipelines, feedback loops, automation, and AI\-assisted development workflows * Integrate new AI capabilities with complex scientific software and existing machine learning systems * Collaborate closely with engineers, ML researchers, and scientists on technically demanding problems **What We’re Looking For** * Exceptional software engineering ability with a track record of building complex production systems, infrastructure, or developer tools * Strong Python experience * Hands\-on experience or serious technical depth in generative AI, AI agents, LLM applications, RAG, or adjacent AI systems * Demonstrated ability to architect systems and carry projects from open\-ended idea to production * Strong computer science and software engineering fundamentals * An exceptional record of academic, technical, research, or professional achievement * Intellectual curiosity and the ability to learn new technical and scientific domains quickly **Preferred** * Scientific computing or research experience * Exposure to computational chemistry, molecular science, or drug discovery workflows **Compensation** Base salary of $250K to $600K, depending on experience, plus significant variable compensation including sign\-on and year\-end bonuses. Hybrid schedule with three days per week in the New York City office.

jobs.title: Applied AI / ML Engineer
jobs.description: * San Francisco, California, United States Location: San Francisco, CA or New York, NY Work Model: Hybrid Employment Type: Full\-Time Compensation: $250,000 to $300,000 base \+ equity **Overview** An early\-stage technology company is building machine learning systems for complex, high\-consequence government applications. The problems are the kind where clean benchmarks do not exist: ground truth is often limited, requirements shift as the mission evolves, and the people using the output need to understand why the model said what it said. The role owns ML systems end to end, from working with end users to define the actual problem, through experimentation and approach selection, to production deployment and ongoing monitoring. It sits at the intersection of research depth and engineering rigor, and a central part of the job is deciding when machine learning is the right tool and when a simpler statistical or software approach will serve users better. The position suits someone who wants full ownership of outcomes rather than a slice of a pipeline, and who values models that are trusted and acted upon over models that are merely sophisticated. **What You’ll Do** * Partner with end users and engineers to understand the underlying problem before committing to a technical approach * Identify, evaluate, and work with complex public and private datasets, including incomplete or sparsely labeled data * Design, test, and compare modeling approaches spanning classical ML, deep learning, probabilistic methods, causal techniques, and generative AI * Architect and deploy end\-to\-end production ML systems, then integrate them into broader software products and workflows * Build and maintain MLOps pipelines and monitor deployed models for drift, degradation, and other production issues * Develop models whose outputs are interpretable enough to be understood, trusted, and acted upon * Communicate technical approaches, limitations, and results clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders **What We’re Looking For** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience building production ML systems * Experience architecting end\-to\-end machine learning systems deployed to real users * Strong ML fundamentals and a track record of evaluating competing modeling approaches * Hands\-on experience across multiple ML paradigms, such as classical ML, deep learning, probabilistic modeling, and generative AI * Experience with imperfect, incomplete, or sparsely labeled real\-world datasets * Demonstrated ability to take models from experimentation through production deployment and monitoring * Strong technical judgment and comfort making decisions under ambiguity * Ability to balance model performance against interpretability and practical usefulness * Strong written and verbal communication skills **Preferred** * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline * Prior ML work in a startup or similarly high\-ownership environment * Experience explaining sophisticated technical work to nontechnical audiences * Prior exposure to government or defense applications **Compensation** $250,000 to $300,000 base salary plus equity, depending on experience and qualifications. Competitive benefits are provided.

This role provides technical and project leadership for the planning, and design of BAS/PMS and integrated control systems and develops and maintains DLB controls standards. jobs.title: IT Service Manager

and access management tools like Okta, and how they intersect with security and compliance requirements. * Experience building or maturing security and compliance controls, such as endpoint compliance reviews — working effectively in support of another owner's strategy. * A track record of automating manual IT workflows through scripting or self\-service tooling to reduce ticket volume and improve consistency. * Scripting experience in Python, and working with Claude Code and other AI tooling for building automation and self\-service tools and supporting Security functions as needed. . * technical issues for non\-technical stakeholders. ### **Bonus Points** * ISO 27001 (or similar framework) certification, or direct experience supporting an ISO audit. * Prior IT experience in a regulated industry or another SaaS company handling sensitive data. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- ### **Within 90 Days You'll:** * Learn DataGrail's systems, tools, and team, ISO\-relevant controls in place, early automation and self\-service initiatives underway, and functioning as an active hands\-on execution partner to the security engineer. ### **Within 365 Days Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, engineers work on real\-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. But you stay connected to your research roots as an active contributor to the wider research community by partnering with universities and publishing papers. Engineers on the Polaris team design tasks that test Gemini’s ability to complete software engineering work. A task is essentially an in\-depth examination that evaluates how well Gemini performs in a specific, complex scenario. The primary components of a task are: a prompt that instructs Gemini what to do and a grader or rubric that assigns a numerical score to the model’s attempted solution. Our team, Polaris, is distinguished primarily by how much manual effort we put into building individual tasks. Rather than generating a large number of tasks using a synthetic data pipeline, engineers on the Polaris team prioritize creating a smaller number of tasks that more closely capture the realism and complexity of real\-world software engineering. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: Description: We are seeking a hands\-on Forward\-Deployed Product Engineer to help maintain, support, and extend a portfolio of production software products. This is a coding role first — but it is a coding role for someone who wants to sit close to the business, talk directly to the people using the software, and own outcomes rather than tickets. You will work across the full software development lifecycle: scoping problems with stakeholders, designing the approach, writing the code, testing it, shipping it, and supporting it in production. Our stack centers on Angular and TypeScript on the front end, with Node.js, Firebase, Firestore, and Google Cloud Platform behind it, plus PostgreSQL where relational data is the right fit. Claude Code and other AI\-assisted development tools are part of our daily workflow. The ideal candidate is a practical software generalist with strong Angular fundamentals, genuine communication skills, and curiosity about why a feature is being requested in the first place. You will not only write code — you will help improve how our products are maintained, supported, tested, documented, and enhanced over time. **IS THIS ROLE FOR YOU?** ========================= You will work across several products and industries in a given quarter, and you will talk to the people who use what you build. If you want to go three years deep on a single product with a product manager between you and the customer, this is not that role. If you like variety, ownership, and direct contact with the business, it is a very good one. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** ========================================= **Engineering and Delivery** ---------------------------- * Own features end\-to\-end across multiple projects — from scoping conversations through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch support. * Maintain and evolve Angular front ends, including component and service architecture, RxJS, routing, state management, dependency updates, UI improvements, and cross\-browser compatibility. * Build and modify backend logic and services using Node.js and TypeScript, including Firebase Cloud Functions, scheduled jobs, and third\-party integrations. * Work confidently in inherited codebases you did not write, including applications of different vintages, conventions, and framework versions. * Perform safe refactoring, code cleanup, and modernization without creating unnecessary disruption for users. * Develop and maintain unit tests, integration tests, and release validation practices appropriate to the risk of each change. * Use Claude Code and other AI\-assisted development tools as a daily part of the workflow — reviewing, steering, and validating generated output rather than shipping it unexamined. **Platform, Data, and Cloud** ----------------------------- * Build and maintain Firebase and Google Cloud Platform backends, including Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, Hosting, and related services. * Design data models across both NoSQL (Firestore) and relational (PostgreSQL) stores, and exercise judgment about when each is the right tool. * Write and tune SQL queries, manage schema changes, and support reporting and data extract needs. * Implement and maintain Firestore security rules, authentication flows, and role\-based permissions. * Manage cloud resources with attention to uptime, security, performance, and cost efficiency. * Maintain version control discipline, deployment readiness, and CI/CD workflows. **Business Partnership and Product Ownership** ---------------------------------------------- * Sit in directly with business stakeholders and end users to translate vague or evolving problems into concrete technical requirements — then build the solution. * Ask why a feature is being requested, and push back constructively when there is a simpler, cheaper, or more durable approach. * Translate business needs into clear technical tasks, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans. * Contribute to estimation, sprint planning, prioritization, and roadmap conversations rather than waiting for fully specified tickets. * Develop working familiarity with the business context of each product — the industry, the workflow, and what it costs the customer when the software is wrong. * Communicate status, risk, and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical audiences in writing and in person. **Support, Release, and Documentation** --------------------------------------- * Serve as the technical owner for escalated support issues, determining whether an issue is user error, configuration, defect, data problem, or a feature request. * Investigate production issues, identify root causes, implement fixes, and put safeguards in place to prevent recurrence. * Own or support the release process, including deployment coordination, testing, release notes, and post\-launch follow\-up. * Maintain current technical documentation covering application architecture, integrations, code changes, troubleshooting steps, and release history. * Perform special projects and other duties as assigned. Requirements: * 3\+ years of relevant software development, SaaS engineering, application support, or product engineering experience preferred. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred, but equivalent hands\-on experience is fully acceptable. * Strong Angular fundamentals — components, services, RxJS, routing, and state management — deep enough to transfer across projects with different conventions and framework versions. * Solid TypeScript and JavaScript skills; comfortable working in a typed codebase and committed to keeping it that way. * Working Node.js experience for backend services, Cloud Functions, scripting, and integrations. * Hands\-on experience with Firebase and Google Cloud Platform, including Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, and Hosting. * SQL fluency, ideally with PostgreSQL, including query writing, joins, and basic performance awareness. * Experience with Git, CI/CD concepts, deployment workflows, testing practices, bug tracking, and production troubleshooting. * Comfortable using AI\-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor while maintaining human review and quality control. * Genuinely strong written and verbal communication — able to explain a technical tradeoff to a non\-technical stakeholder and write a status update that does not generate follow\-up questions. * Comfort with ambiguity and frequent context\-switching across clients in different industries. * Self\-directed working style with light supervision — able to unblock yourself, and willing to escalate early when you cannot. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, respond to support needs, and maintain professionalism under pressure. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ============================ * Prior consulting, agency, forward\-deployed engineering, or other client\-facing delivery experience. * Experience supporting an established SaaS product, legacy application, government software, legal or court software, or a regulated workflow platform. * Experience with public sector, records, filing, case management, document management, or workflow software. * Experience supporting or modernizing older Angular versions and migrating them forward. * Experience with APIs, authentication, permissions models, reporting tools, and system integrations. * Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions or Cloud Build. * Experience with Jira, Zoho, Notion, Trello, GitHub Issues, or similar project and ticket tracking systems. * A track record of improving testing, documentation, deployment reliability, or developer productivity on a team. **CORE COMPETENCIES** ===================== End\-to\-End Ownership Angular Craftsmanship Cloud and Data Judgment Stakeholder Communication Business Curiosity Problem Solving Product Judgment AI\-Assisted Development Documentation Accountability Customer Service Mindset Continuous Improvement

PAM** * Serve as the technical point of contact for all IGA implementation and development efforts. * Assist in the design and development of IGA connectors and integrations with enterprise applications — SaaS, on\-premise, and cloud. * Build and configure certification campaigns in Saviynt (user access reviews, entitlement certifications, role certifications), including workflows and least\-privilege access across critical systems. * Maintain the data quality behind certifications — identity correlation, role definitions, and application onboarding into Saviynt **Non\-Human \& Agentic Identity Governance** * Govern the full lifecycle of non\-human identities (NHIs) — service accounts, machine identities, secrets, and API credentials — including discovery, ownership assignment, risk\-tiering, and periodic recertification. * Extend the identity governance plane to AI agents — registering agents, scoping least\-privilege access via Saviynt, integrating with secrets management (e.g., Azure Key Vault), and enforcing runtime guardrails and approval gates. * Help eliminate shadow agents and orphaned NHIs through continuous discovery, dormancy detection, and drift alerts. **Automation \& AI\-Driven Engineering** * Champion an automation\-first approach — identifying manual identity and access processes that can be eliminated, self\-serviced, or fully automated. * Design and maintain automation using REST APIs, JSON, SQL, and scripting languages (PowerShell, Python, JavaScript). * Leverage AI\-powered tools and agents (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to including Saviynt’s native AI/rapid\-onboarding capabilities. **Compliance, Audit \& Operations** * Support audit readiness and access attestation for regulatory and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, requests through ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow), ensuring SLA adherence, and mentor junior engineers on identity concepts and tooling. **Required Qualifications** * Strong understanding of IAM principles, including user lifecycle management, role\-based access control (RBAC), least privilege, and segregation of duties (SoD), and PAM. * 5\+ years of hands\-on IAM engineering experience, including deep, demonstrable expertise configuring and developing on Saviynt EIC (IGA). * Demonstrated experience with enterprise\-scale IAM implementations, ideally in organizations with hundreds of applications. * Proficient with REST APIs, JSON, SQL, and scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python, JavaScript). * Experience conducting or supporting access certification campaigns, audit activities, and compliance\-driven controls. * Familiarity with application infrastructure and architecture (Windows/Linux, cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, GCP). * Excellent troubleshooting, debugging, communication, and documentation skills. * Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast\-paced environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with PAM platforms, procedures, implementations, and best practices. (Privileged Access Management). * Experience governing non\-human and/or agentic (AI agent) identities and secrets management (e.g., Azure Key Vault). * Knowledge of Active Directory, Azure AD, and identity federation technologies (SAML, OAuth, OIDC). * Experience using AI tools and developing agents (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to improve operational efficiency. * Prior experience in regulated environments (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR). * IAM certifications (e.g., CIAM, CISSP, Saviynt Certified Professional) are a plus. * 5\+ years of hands\-on development experience with IGA, including configuration, workflows, and conn  recognized global standard for project\-based businesses, Deltek delivers software and information solutions to help organizations achieve their purpose. Our market leadership stems from the work of our diverse employees who are united by a passion for learning, growing and making a difference. At Deltek, we take immense pride in creating a balanced, values\-driven environment, where every employee feels included and empowered to do their best work. Our employees put our core values into action daily, creating a one\-of\-a\-kind culture that has been recognized globally. Thanks to our incredible team, Deltek has been named one of America’s Best Midsize Employers by Forbes, a Best Place to Work by Glassdoor, a Top Workplace by The Washington Post and a Best Place to Work in Asia by World HRD Congress. www.deltek.com At Deltek, security isn’t a gate at the end of the process — it’s in the foundation. Enterprise Security \& Technology Services (ESTS) brings together security, infrastructure, and technology operations under one organization, led by our CISO, with a mandate to make sure Deltek builds and operates with integrity at every layer. We’re a passionate team of technologists and security professionals who work across the entire company — embedded in how services are built, delivered, and supported. We run agile, we embrace intelligent automation to amplify what our people can do, and we hold ourselves to a high standard because the organizations that depend on Deltek’s platform are doing work that can’t afford mistakes. If you take your craft seriously, want visibility into how a complex, global technology organization really operates, and believe security should be a first principle — not an afterthought — this is a team that will feel like home. Certain roles may have additional privacy, security and compliance requirements to the extent they support Costpoint GCCM or similar product offerings. *Deltek, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. They exercise independent operational judgment, take ownership of outcomes, and lead through clarity of expectations, professional managerial standards, and accountability. They contribute an operational perspective to emerging strategies, including AI infrastructure. They manage a multidisciplinary team of employees, consultants, and contractors, with the function expected to scale alongside Denali’s South San Francisco, Salt Lake City, and Zurich operational footprint. **Key Responsibilities** **Leadership \& Architectural Partnership** ------------------------------------------- * Lead IT Infrastructure as a function, owning the operational agenda, operating rhythms, and standards by which the team executes * Build and maintain the management structures, operating cadences, escalation paths, and accountability mechanisms required for reliable delivery * Anticipate operational risks, capacity constraints, attrition, and capability gaps, and act in advance of service impact * Operate Platform Engineering decisions within architectural standards and governance forums set by Architecture, including the Architecture Review Board (ARB) for decisions of architectural significance; bring operational experience into architectural decisions and execute engineering work within architectural intent * Represent Platform Engineering \& Operations to peer functions at the appropriate working level; contribute operational perspective disruptions Lead, develop, and grow the team; set clear expectations, performance standards, and accountability; build team operating cadences, on\-call rotations, and capacity planning * **Required Qualifications** * 9\+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant time in platform engineering, infrastructure, IT service management, or IT operations * 3\+ years of direct team leadership experience, including building management structures, operating cadences, and accountability mechanisms required for reliable team delivery * Demonstrated experience setting and driving the operational agenda for a function and contributing operational perspective to enterprise or cross\-functional strategy decisions, with specific examples of identifying what needed attention and what was brought to the table * Demonstrated experience holding operational standards through attrition, competing priorities, or pressure to deprioritize, with specific examples * Demonstrated experience jobs.title: AI Governance Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Dentsu is operationalizing AI at scale. Across every brand and practice, business teams are identifying AI\-powered tools, platforms, and vendors they want to deploy — and they need a fast, expert path through the governance process to do it safely. The AI Governance Concierge Service is dentsu's answer to that challenge — a dedicated, end\-to\-end service that gives any Americas business team a single expert point of contact for AI product adoption. The AI Governance Engineer is the process navigator, program manager, and technical implementer of the service. Working in close coordination with the AI Governance Service Lead, the Governance Engineer receives each submission package approved by the Lead, thoroughly understands its contents — the business case, the vendor research, the risk profile, and the policy alignment — and takes full ownership of driving it through the cross\-functional review process. The Engineer is expected to speak to the details of every submission they manage, serve as the knowledgeable point of contact for all reviewing functions, coordinate with the Analyst when additional research or documentation is needed, and own the end\-to\-end implementation once approval is granted. This role ensures nothing stalls, nothing is lost, and every engagement crosses the finish line. The AI Governance Concierge Service is not simply an approval function — it is a service built around bringing every engagement to a successful conclusion. That means approving solutions that meet dentsu's standards, identifying alternative products or approaches that address the business need within governance requirements, and providing solutions that facilitate approval where possible. When risks are identified that prevent approval, the service's role is to clearly document and communicate those risks and leave the decision to the business to weigh the risk and reward. Success is a business team that always has a clear path forward — not just a ruling. **What You Will Do** **Submission Intake \& Program Management** * Receive and thoroughly review each submission package approved by the Service Lead — developing a deep understanding of the business case, vendor research, risk profile, and policy rationale before the review process begins. * Project\-manage each submission through the full review lifecycle in AIRS and TPSA — tracking every open item, deadline, and reviewer action from submission to final determination. * Set and communicate the review schedule for each submission based on priorities identified and communicated by the Lead; maintain that schedule actively throughout the review and implementation phases. * Update the AI Concierge Program Tracker with accurate, real\-time progress during the review and implementation phases, ensuring the Service Lead always has a current view across all active engagements. * Work closely with the Analyst when reviewers require additional research, documentation, or clarification — coordinating the request clearly, reviewing what comes back for completeness, and routing it to the appropriate reviewing function without delay. * Report status, progress, and blockers to the Service Lead on a regular cadence, enabling the Lead to keep the business team accurately informed at all times. **Cross\-Functional Review \& Relationships** * Build and maintain trusted working relationships with counterparts in Legal, Information Security, Data Privacy, Emerging Technology, and Procurement — positioning the Concierge Service as an organized, reliable partner that makes their review process easier, not harder. * Shepherd each submission through the full cross\-functional review process — serving as the knowledgeable, primary point of contact for all reviewing functions, engaging each group with the context and detail they need to review confidently. * Partner with Global Enterprise Technology to shepherd each request through the review process, ensure Global Enterprise Technology's requirements are met at the engagement level, and coordinate the technical backend of implementation. * Translate technical and legal concerns from reviewers back to the Service Lead and Analyst in plain language — enabling accurate communication to the business team and ensuring the Analyst has what they need to produce any required follow\-up documentation. **Escalation \& Risk Management** * Identify blockers within the governance or review process and surface them to the Service Lead immediately with clear context and recommended resolution paths. * Own the follow\-through on blockers — actively working to resolve open items, maintaining momentum on stalled submissions, and not waiting for issues to resolve themselves. * Escalate risk\-flagged items to the Service Lead and relevant stakeholders; document disposition rationale for all escalated items. **Implementation \& Delivery** * Upon approval, own and coordinate the full implementation of each approved solution — working w n, and clear communication. * Clear, precise communicator — able to translate between technical, legal, and business audiences without losing accuracy in either direction. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a media, marketing, advertising, or professional services organization. * Familiarity with GenAI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO 42001\) or data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA). * Hands\-on experience with enterprise AI platforms (Claude Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, or similar) and their enterprise deployment requirements. * Background in vendor risk assessment, third\-party due diligence, or enterprise technology procurement. * Experience with Coupa, ServiceNow, OneTrust, or similar enterprise workflow and compliance platforms. * IAPP AIGP, CIPP, CISSP, PMP, or equivalent certification is a plus. **What Success Looks Like** In your first 90 days, you have taken ownership of the active submission queue, established working relationships with your counterparts in Legal, Privacy, Security, Emerging Technology, Procurement, and Global Enterprise Technology, and can speak confidently to the details of every submission in your queue. You have a clear, documented view of where every open engagement stands and what is needed to move each one forward. At six months, the average time\-to\-approval has measurably decreased. No submission goes dark — every open item has an owner, a deadline, and a next action. Reviewing functions know who you are and trust that you come prepared. You have completed at least one end\-to\-end implementation, and the Analyst rarely needs to be pulled back into a submission once it has entered your review queue. At one year, the Governance Engineer function is recognized across the review community as a reliable, organized partner. The implementation pipeline is clean, the CSDM is accurate, and the post\-launch review process is a standard part of every engagement. Your process improvements have meaningfully reduced the manual effort required to move a submission from intake to closure. The annual salary range for this position is $82,500 \- $130,000\. jobs.description: The purpose of this role is to develop best in class strategies and management of all Insights and Analysis activity on assigned clients, to manage and develop the team and serve as a point of escalation as needed.**Job Description:** Merkle's Commerce Analytics \& Intelligence practice helps the world's largest retailers, brands, and marketplaces turn data into decisions across the four Ps — product, price, promotion, and place — and against the competitive market. We are moving from an embedded, staff\-augmentation delivery model to a craft\-led consultancy: named specialists organized by discipline, US\-onshore leadership in front of a global delivery engine, and value measured by the decisions we enable rather than the hours we bill. The Director, Commerce Analytics is a US\-based onshore craft leader accountable for one of our largest enterprise accounts. You pair fluent business acumen with a strong technical foundation — AI and machine learning, Python, SQL, and cloud computation — and you use both to own the analytics craft end to end: consumer decision modeling, pricing and promotion, assortment and space, and competitive intelligence. You lead a blended onshore/offshore pod, sit at the client's table as a trusted advisor, and translate business need into a delivery plan the offshore engine executes. This is a build role: you are shaping how the practice operates as much as running the work. **What you will own** * **Client partnership.**Be the senior analytics voice the client relies on — present the standard rather than wait for the ask, bring proposals not order\-taking, and hold the relationship at the business\-decision altitude, not the report altitude. * **The craft.**Own the analytics discipline across the account: consumer decision modeling and the semantic/decisioning layer, pricing and promotion, assortment and localization, digital shelf and competitive intelligence — the me\-vs\-market view of the four Ps. * **A blended pod.**Lead a flat, project\-based team drawn from a single global Merkle pool — onshore practitioners in front, offshore engineering and data\-science engines behind. Assemble teams around projects, not titles; project leadership follows the work. * **Delivery you can prove.**Stand up and run a value cadence: weekly delivery status with dated milestones, risks and dependencies; monthly project\-based business readouts per area; and a scorecard that shows the client what their investment returns — baselines stated honestly, targets met. * **Documentation and governance.**Ensure solutions live visibly in the client's environment with current documentation, clear workflows, and a governance standard any party can pick up — closing the gap between what the team delivers and what the client can see. * **Growth.**Convert delivered value into expansion — new decisions, new areas, new scope — and feed the account's forward pipeline in partnership with account and client\-success leadership. **What you will bring** * **Fluent business acumen.**You read a P\&L and a merchant's world with equal ease — you can move between the four Ps and the levers behind them (traffic, transaction, units, conversion, margin), translate a business question into an analytical answer and back, and hold your own in a boardroom, not just a data review. * **Strong technical background.**Deep, hands\-credible expertise across the modern analytics and AI stack — AI and machine learning, Python, SQL, and cloud computation (e.g., GCP, AWS, or Azure and their data/ML services) — plus fluency in the market\-leading tooling of the moment: LLMs and agentic/GenAI, semantic and decisioning layers, experimentation and attribution platforms, and modern BI. You have sat on the merchant or business side of these decisions, not just the reporting side. * **Consulting and client leadership.**You have led senior client relationships as a trusted advisor, set the analytical standard, and navigated a large, matrixed client organization — comfortable proposing the path rather than executing a spec. * **Onshore/offshore delivery leadership.**You have led blended teams across time zones and shores, translated business intent into a technical plan, and held delivery quality and dates without a heavy management layer beneath you. * **A build\-and\-shepherd temperament.**You set standards, raise risks early, escalate rather than absorb, and grow people by the work they lead — not by title. **What sets the strongest candidates apart** * Direct experience inside a big\-box or enterprise retailer's merchandising, category management, pricing, or online organization. * Experience standing up a decisioning or semantic\-layer product, business decision engines — taking it from concept to a governed, enterprise\-wide capability. * A track record of converting a delivery relationship into a strategic, consultative partnership — and growing it. **How this role fits** This Director sits within Merkle's DBT\-aligned Commerce Analytics practice, reporting into practice leadership, with account P\&L owned above the role. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Systems
jobs.description: Job description Company and benefits Social Impact \& Sustainability Job ID 41663 **About Us** Dolby Cloud Solutions is a video streaming software company that helps enterprise and mid\-market organizations deliver exceptional audio and video experiences to their audiences. The Dolby OptiView SaaS platform serves a growing portfolio of customers across media, advertising, and real\-time communications — with a mission to make immersive video experiences accessible and scalable for everyone. **About This Role** Dolby Cloud Solutions is embedding AI into the core of how it operates — not as a side project, but as a fundamental shift in how work gets done across the business. The philosophy guiding this work is simple: AI prepares, humans decide. This is a Staff\-level engineering role at the center of that effort. You will own the technical architecture of the shared AI infrastructure that DCS teams build their business processes on — and you will build specific solutions on top of it. You will define the patterns, standards, and integration approaches that others follow, and serve as the technical authority when architectural decisions need to be made. Business problems are owned by business stakeholders. You will work closely with those stakeholders — helping shape requirements and acceptance criteria where needed, then owning the build end to end. You will also collaborate with OptiView Product Engineering on shared infrastructure and systems integration, and engage Product Engineering when platform features or APIs need to be developed to support the work. **What You'll Do** **Own the AI systems architecture** * Define the technical architecture of the shared data and integration layer — not just build it, but set the standards and patterns that others build on top of * Establish integration patterns, credential management standards, and data access models that scale across teams and systems * Ensure the infrastructure is secure, observable, and operable — not just functional at launch **Build and integrate across systems** * Architect and implement the foundational data and integration layer that enables AI agents and applications to operate reliably across business functions * Build and maintain integrations between business systems — CRM, billing, support, product usage, and more — so that data flows where it needs to go * Collaborate with Product Engineering on shared infrastructure, systems integration, and platform capabilities — you know when to build and when to align * Configure and manage MCP servers and API connections to internal systems, with proper credential management and security controls * Stand up shared hosting infrastructure for agents, automations, and applications, moving work off local workstations and into production environments * Build scheduled automations and event\-driven workflows that run reliably without manual intervention **Deliver business solutions** * Work with business stakeholders to understand problems, refine requirements, and define acceptance criteria — then own the build * Develop customer\-facing and internal applications from requirements and user stories — these may be web applications, headless services, agentic flows, or a combination * Build AI\-powered workflows for business teams including customer health monitoring, automated alerts, meeting intelligence, and revenue lifecycle automation * Iterate rapidly: deploy working software, collect feedback, and improve **Raise the technical floor across DCS** * Set the technical bar for how AI systems are built, integrated, and maintained across the organization — your decisions become the standard others follow * Maintain a shared repository of prompts, agents, skills, and workflows organized for reuse across teams * Help colleagues across Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Finance build and deploy their own AI solutions on the shared infrastructure **What You Bring** **Required** * 5\+ years building production software — applications, APIs, backend services, platform infrastructure, or data integrations — with a demonstrated track record of leveraging AI\-assisted development tools (Devin, Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as a core part of engineering delivery * Proven experience making architectural decisions, set technical standards, and influenced how an engineering organization builds * Strong with Python or TypeScript/Node.js; comfortable picking up whatever the job requires * Experience building tool\-use integrations for AI systems; familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar protocols/frameworks is strongly preferred * Proven experience integrating with SaaS APIs (REST, webhooks, OAuth) — you have connected real business systems and understand the edge cases * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic frameworks — you have built production agents or AI\-powered workflows, not just prototypes * Comfortable working with business stakeholders — you can participate in requirements discussions, ask the right questions, push back constructively, and translate business intent into working software * Experienced collaborating with product and platform engineering teams — you know how to articulate what you need, align on approach, and get things built across team boundaries * Security\-conscious: you understand data classification, access controls, API credentials, compliance requirements, and risk management principles, and you incorporate them into the systems you build **Strong Plus** * Experience designing federated data layers, shared integration infrastructure, or multi\-system data pipelines * Familiarity with common SaaS business systems used in revenue, support, or customer success operations * Background in Customer Success, RevOps, or SaaS B2B — you understand the business domain you're building for * Experience incorporating data classification, compliance, security, and risk assessment considerations into the design and operation of AI\-powered systems and business automations

utility distribution standards, industry codes, engineering best practices, and constructability requirements. * Develop and maintain PLS\-Pole models, pole selection tools/spreadsheets, sag\-tension and clearance tables, and other engineering tools used to support consistent and repeatable design. * Prepare and maintain Basis of Design (BOD) documents, design guidelines, engineering methodologies, and technical documentation that clearly define design assumptions, criteria, calculations, and processes to ensure consistency and reproducibility. * Perform structural and engineering analyses for non\-standard or unique applications, including evaluation of poles, structures, connections, base plates, adapters, and other transmission or distribution components. * Provide ad\-hoc technical engineering support to clients and project teams, including evaluation of field conditions, existing infrastructure, constructability issues, and development of engineered solutions. * Collaborate with utility engineering, construction, operations, standards, and project management teams to develop practical engineering solutions and incorporate lessons learned into standards and design practices. * Support the development, review, and continuous improvement of engineering standards, calculation tools, design templates, technical specifications, and construction guidance. *
