current, grounding, lightning, induction, impedance, losses and voltage drop design for transmission line design. * Act as a liason with clients and contractors, coordinating with various disciplines and permitting agencies and excercising project management skills. * Experience with geotechnical data interpretation for foundation design and embedment calculations for a variety of transmission structures types and geotechnical requirements. * Ability to communicate with survey and GIS personnel, interpret survey data, and incorporate it into PLS\-CADD models. * Ensure designs, engineering methodologies, and construction standards comply with applicable industry codes and standards, including ASCE, NESC, AISC, IEEE, and client\-specific  al regulations. **General Responsibilities:*** Conduct site visits to gather data, assess conditions, and support construction as needed. * Perform load calculations, stress analysis, and structural optimization for transmission line components. * Collaborate with project managers, drafters, and other engineers to deliver projects on time and within budget. * Conduct quality checks on designs and ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. * Provide engineering support during construction, including addressing RFI (Requests for Information) and field modifications. * Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and changes to design codes and standards. Qualifications: **Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:** **Education:*** Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, Civil, Structural, or a related Engineering discipline; Master’s degree preferred. * Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain one within 12 months. **Experience:*** 8\+ years of experience in the design of overhead and underground high voltage and extra high voltage transmission lines including route selection, line and structure spotting, structure design \& analysis, and development of construction bid package. * Proficiency in using PLS\-CADD, PLS\-POLE, PLS\-TOWER, L\-Pile, NFAD, and Microsoft Office Suite. * Experience in structural analysis software (e.g., STAAD.Pro, RISA, SAP2000\). * Familiarity with substation design tools such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, or MicroStation. **Skills:*** Strong understanding of industry standards such as ASCE, ACI, AISC, NESC, and IEEE. * Knowledge of soil mechanics, foundation design, and geotechnical principles. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously. * Experience leveraging AI and automation tools responsibly to improve quality, productivity and innovation **Preferred Skills:*** Familiarity with GIS, LIDAR, and terrain modeling for transmission line routing. * Experience with stormwater management and site grading for substations. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Hybrid)
jobs.description: Interested in joining a growing company where you will work with talented colleagues, enhance a supportive and energetic culture, and be part of the climate solution? At Energy Solutions, we focus on the big impacts. And we believe that market\-based programs can be a powerful force to deliver large\-scale energy, carbon, and water\-use savings. Since 1995, we've harnessed that power to offer proven, performance\-based solutions for our utility, government, and institutional customers. The Information Systems (IS) team is seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** to provide technical direction and establish complex software solutions that support critical business applications and long\-term technology objectives. As a senior individual contributor, this role leads software architecture, technical design, and engineering decisions that other teams and projects utilizing the Mendix platform rely on. Solutions must be scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with business and client needs. Operating with a high degree of independence, the Senior Software Engineer evaluates technical requirements, sets direction on solution alternatives, and contributes to technical strategy within their domain. In addition, this role will mentor junior level engineers, through code reviews, technical guidance, solution design discussions, and knowledge sharing, while supporting engineering best practices, technical standards, and continuous improvement initiatives across the development team. **Responsibilities include but are not limited to:** **Software Development \& Architecture:** * Lead the design and development of complex software systems, features, services, and integrations across all projects and multiple teams utilizing the Mendix platform. * Design scalable, secure, modular, and maintainable software solutions that support current and anticipated business and client needs. * Develop full\-stack software solutions and technical designs that align with platform architecture, engineering standards, and business requirements. * Establish architecture and technical design standards adopted across multiple applications, systems, projects, and shared technology platforms. **Technical Leadership \& Capability Development** * Serve as a technical subject matter expert and escalation point for complex software engineering questions and decisions across multiple teams utilizing the Mendix platform. * Review code changes by other engineers regularly to ensure alignment with engineering, architecture, security, testing, documentation, and quality standards. * Mentor and coach engineers across multiple teams and Mendix projects through technical guidance, solution design discussions, pair programming, code reviews, and constructive feedback. * Lead technical strategy within their domain and establish engineering standards, technical approaches, system design decisions adopted across multiple projects and shared technology platforms. **Project Support \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning multiple teams involving system integration, APIs, data exchange, platform modernization, and performance optimization. * Partner with business stakeholders to understand operational objectives, translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable software solutions. * Lead the Identification and communication of technical risks, dependencies, trade\-offs, and mitigation strategies to project teams, engineering leads, and senior leadership as needed. **Agile Development \& Delivery** * Lead technical discussions during sprint planning, backlog refinement, architecture reviews, and retrospectives across teams. * Recommend and implement improvements to engineering processes, workflows, tools, and delivery practices adopted across teams. **Operational Excellence \& Deployment Support** * Lead incident response, root\-cause analysis, and implementation of sustainable corrective actions across teams. * Evaluate application performance, reliability, scalability, capacity, and operational effectiveness and lead the implementation of proactive improvements. * Ensure software systems and changes align with established security, privacy, data protection, and compliance requirements. * Guide and implement release planning, deployment validation, production readiness, and operational monitoring activities across teams. * Participate in on\-call rotations and provide advanced technical direction for complex production incidents. * Lead automation, monitoring, and operational improvements that reduce recurring issues and strengthen system resilience across teams. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. * 10 years of experience developing, supporting, and enhancing complex software systems and applications. * Advanced proficiency in full\-stack software development and one or more prog t practices, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, automation, and production support. * Experience contributing to architectural and technical design decisions across applications, systems, platforms, or codebases. * Experience evaluating technical trade\-offs and recommending solutions that balance business requirements, delivery timelines, scalability, and long\-term maintainability. * Experience collaborating with engineering teams and stakeholders to support technical direction across multiple projects or shared technology platforms. * Experience mentoring engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, solution design discussions, and knowledge sharing. * Experience partnering with Product, Quality Assurance, Project Management, DevOps, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to deliver software solutions. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong mentoring, coaching, collaboration, and technical leadership skills. * Ability to manage multiple technical priorities and operate effectively in complex and evolving environments. * Ability to work independently while maintaining alignment with established engineering standards, architectural direction, and organizational objectives. **The Salary Range for this role is $140,000 \- $175,000/annually with a target compensation of $140k \- $157,500/Annually.** Compensation is commensurate with experience and includes a generous retirement package. Energy Solutions provides an excellent benefits package including medical, dental and vision insurance, other pre\-tax contribution plans and an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). **AI Use** At Energy Solutions we believe in the importance of authentic interactions and equitable opportunities. To ensure the integrity and fairness of our interview process, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools (including Generative AI) or other means to generate or assist with responses during interviews is strictly prohibited. We afford equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by law. Energy Solutions conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations. **Office Locations and a Remote Workforce** Energy Solutions operates as a predominantly remote workforce with offices in six different locations. Employees who reside within 40 miles of an office (except New York) will be assigned to that location, though in\-office attendance requirements may vary by team. At this time, we are not accepting applications from candidates residing in the following states: Delaware, Kentucky, Mississippi, Montana, Nebraska, and North Dakota. **Background Check Information** Information will be requested to perform the compulsory background check. A drug screen and authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely are preconditions of employment. alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences. * This position pays between $101,600\- 175,200, based on experience * This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require. \#LI\-BT1 \#LI\-Remote **Join an award\-winning company** Five\-time winner of “Best in Energage Top Workplaces USA 2022\-2024 Fortune Media Best Workplaces in Healthcare 2024 Monster Top Workplace for Remote Work 2024 Great Place to Work certified 2023\-2024 * Innovation * Work\-Life Each associate will earn a professional certification relevant to their field and can obtain tuition reimbursement. * **Recognition –** We offer quarterly and annual incentive programs for all employees who go beyond and keep raising the bar for themselves and the company. jobs.title: Software Engineer- PHP
jobs.description: Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine\-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI\-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e\-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community. **Job Description** We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team. This role will be to develop information systems by studying operations; designing, developing and installing software solutions; support and develop the software team. In this role, you will work with leadership to define software requirements and take the lead on operational and technical projects. We’re seeking a Software Engineer with strong object\-oriented programming experience (PHP preferred, but open to other OOP languages) and a thoughtful interest in how AI can enhance modern software development. In this role, you’ll take ownership of meaningful features and components, contribute across the full development lifecycle, and collaborate closely with senior engineers to build scalable, secure, and maintainable systems. This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving moderately complex problems, writing high\-quality code, and using AI\-assisted tools to work more efficiently—while maintaining strong engineering judgment, reliability, and security standards **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and maintain small\-to\-medium features and services using object\-oriented design principles (PHP preferred; experience in Java, C\#, Python, Ruby, or similar is welcome). * Own technical implementation for assigned work, from design through deployment, with limited oversight. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar) to improve productivity, accelerate debugging, and support test creation—while validating outputs and ensuring quality. * Design reusable, testable components that align with existing architecture, interfaces, and coding standards. * Diagnose and resolve non\-trivial bugs and performance issues; leverage logs, metrics, and traces to identify root causes. * Contribute meaningfully to automated testing efforts, including unit and integration tests, and help improve overall test coverage. * Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and mentoring junior engineers when appropriate. * Apply secure coding practices and proactively address common web and application security risks. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers during sprint planning, estimation, and backlog refinement. * Maintain and improve technical documentation, using AI tools to assist with clarity, accuracy, and ongoing updates. * Stay current on emerging engineering and AI\-assisted development practices and share effective techniques with the team. **What You Bring** **Required** * 4\+ years of professional software development experience in an object\-oriented language (PHP preferred). * Strong understanding of OOP principles, design patterns, and clean code practices. * Experience working in a Linux\-based development environment. * Proficiency with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS3\. * Solid experience with relational databases and SQL/MySQL. * Working understanding of system architecture concepts, debugging strategies, and observability fundamentals (logs, metrics, tracing). * Demonstrated commitment to code quality, testing, and maintainable design. * Practical experience using (or strong interest in) AI tools for coding, debugging, testing, or documentation in a responsible way. **Nice to Have** * Experience with Docker or containerized environments. * Exposure to AWS or other cloud platforms. * Experience using AI to improve engineering workflows (e.g., repeatable prompts, test generation, or faster root\-cause analysis). **Additional Information** -------------------------- While we've outlined some key qualities we typically seek, it's essential to remember that there might be additional unique strengths and talents you possess that would make you an exceptional match for us, even if they're not explicitly mentioned. Studies have consistently highlighted the significance of this principle, particularly for individuals from disenfranchised backgrounds, including women and other marginalized groups. These individuals often hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement, unlike their male counterparts who are more inclined to apply when they meet around 60% of the criteria. The message we want to convey is that taking a leap of faith and applying can be incredibly rewarding. Your distinct abilities and perspectives could be exactly what we need to create a more diverse and inclusive team. So, don't hesitate—apply today and let's explore the exciting possibilities together! All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. At **En****sora Health**, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging aren’t just words. We celebrate what makes us unique, foster an ecosystem of inclusion for all and harness our talents to promote diversity of thought and action in everything we do. We instill Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging into the fabric of our CARING culture and business, as we strive to be recognized not only as the leader in healthcare technology, but also for our intentional efforts to promote a diverse community. We will champion non\-discriminatory practices throughout the employee and customer lifecycle; caring for every person regardless of race, national origin, color, religion, disability, sex, orientation, or familial status. **Ensora Health** is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description: **Job Title:** Lab Automation \& AI Engineering Co\-Op**Job Description:** Here at Entegris, we use advanced science to enable technologies that transform the world, and we are seeking employees who have the drive to continue the mission. **The Role:** * Our site in Billerica, MA is seeking a Lab Automation \& AI Engineering Co\-Op to join our team for the Spring 2027 season. This assignment is intended to be 6 months in duration. * This is a hands\-on opportunity to apply coding and AI skills to real laboratory challenges — helping automate manual workflows, streamline data handling, and prototype AI\-assisted tools that improve lab efficiency and data quality. * You will work alongside lab managers, scientists, and analysts to understand real lab processes and build practical, reliable tools that make everyday lab work faster and more consistent. This is a great fit for a student who enjoys working at the intersection of science, data, and automation. **What You’ll Do:** * Support automation of manual lab workflows such as data processing, QC review, and report generation. * Develop and test Python scripts or tools for data analysis, cleanup, and automation. * Help prototype and evaluate AI\-assisted tools (e.g., large language models, AI jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer II
jobs.description: **Senior Full Stack Engineer II, B2B Agency Feature Team** **Location:** Cambridge, MA / Hybrid *(This role requires working in\-office 3 days per week: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.)* **About us:** EverQuote is a leading AI\-powered growth solutions partner for regulated property and casualty insurance entities, enabling the largest insurance carriers and thousands of agents to maximize customer acquisition across digital channels. Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share. Joining our team puts you at the forefront of this transformation. You will collaborate with a group of builders to solve complex problems and reshape a massive industry. If you want to drive real\-world impact and do the best work of your career, you've found your home. We move fast, follow the data, and hold ourselves to high standards. If that's how you work too, this is the role for you. **About the role:** EverQuote is searching for a Senior Engineer II, Full Stack to join our B2B Agency Feature Team, one of the highest\-impact teams driving the future of our Agency business. This is not just another engineering role. You'll be at the center of everything, partnering directly with every platform team to architect, build, and scale the agency features that power EverQuote's B2B growth engine. Your work will directly shape how agencies interact with our platform and unlock revenue at scale. You'll own the development of cutting\-edge, user\-facing applications and interactive services that are fast, resilient, and built to handle massive growth. Think bold UI innovations, seamless front\-end architecture, and experiences that agencies can't live without. You'll join a team of hungry, collaborative engineers who move fast and ship with purpose. But you won't just contribute, you'll lead. As a technical mentor, you'll elevate the entire team's game through deep expertise in modern front\-end development, exceptional UI/UX execution, and forward\-thinking adoption of AI tools that supercharge developer productivity. If you want to build products that move the needle, mentor a world\-class team, and leave a mark on a platform that's scaling fast, this is the role. **What you'll do:** * Design large\-scale UI systems and communicate designs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders (Product, Design). * Share knowledge and mentor teammates in advanced front\-end concepts. * Quickly diagnose and solve complex front\-end code problems, as well as help others unblock themselves. * Use data (e.g., A/B testing, performance monitoring) to support and validate your UI/UX concepts. * Integrate AI tools into the development lifecycle (e.g., for testing, code assistance, or feature implementation). * Contribute every day to the user experience in a fast\-paced work environment. **What you bring to the team:** * 8\+ years of professional programming experience, with deep, hands\-on expertise building scalable full\-stack solutions, encompassing equally solid front\-end architecture and robust backend systems in production environments. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. * Expert experience with modern front\-end frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, Angular) and Typescript. * Proficient in component\-based architecture and have experience with Docker/Kubernetes for front\-end build and deployment processes. * Proven experience in technical leadership, mentoring junior engineers, and driving complex projects to completion. * You have an entrepreneurial mindset, want to grow a business, and love working with a team on user\-facing products. * You thrive in a fast\-paced work environment where everyday contributions to the user experience have a big impact * You have proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software. * You possess knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) principles, and you can identify opportunities to properly leverage AI tools and technologies in daily development activities to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and drive innovation in user\-facing products. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant's job\-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location. The base salary range for this full\-time hybrid position is $174,800\-$205,700\. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in variable cash bonus programs, equity, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility which are designated by role. Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE range for your role during the hiring process. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must have current, unrestricted work authorization in the United States. EverQuote is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy or a pregnancy\-related condition, veteran or military status, or any other protected characteristic. Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs or practices, upon request. For more information, visit https://investors.everquote.com and follow on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Director of Product, AI
jobs.description: The Elevator Pitch: Evolv Technology is looking for a Director of Product, AI, a senior individual contributor who will work at the center of our AI engineering and research teams to build the industry's best weapons detection and computer vision capabilities. You will get deep into the mechanics of how we collect data, define annotation standards, evaluate models, run field trials, and deploy detection systems into the real world, translating that work into product decisions to keep people safe. You will embed directly with AI engineering as the product lead for our detection capabilities, operating with the technical depth to make and defend decisions about data, models, and evaluation methodology. What Winning Looks Like**In the first 30 days, you will**: Pressure\-test how we collect data, set annotation standards, evaluate models, and run field trials. Come back with a sharp read on the biggest gaps, risks, and decisions, and a plan to move on them. **Within 90 days, you will:** Ship a prioritized data collection strategy across the scenarios and threats that matter most. Lock annotation, dataset quality, and validation standards with AI engineering. Define the release\-readiness bar, including accuracy, false positive/negative rates, latency, throughput, and real\-world load, then get alignment on it. Turn field\-trial results into real product and model decisions. Build the operating cadence and decision framework that keeps detection performance moving. **Within 6 months, you will**: Own detection. You're the accountable product lead driving data priorities, model evaluation, release readiness, trade\-offs, in lockstep with AI engineering and research. Shape the roadmap, balancing performance against latency, compute cost, hardware limits, and customer experience. Make sure every external claim about detection performance is accurate and defensible, and push hard with legal and compliance to get there. **By the end of the first year, you will**: Demonstrate measurable improvement in detection performance and release predictability across priority use cases. Show that the operating mechanisms you established are consistently identifying performance gaps, driving timely decisions, and improving deployed models. Influence the longer\-term detection roadmap through clear evidence about customer needs, technical trade\-offs, and business impact. What you’ll own**AI/ML Lifecycle Ownership** * Define data collection strategy: what scenarios, environments, and threat types need more or better training data * Own annotation guidelines in partnership with AI engineering * Partner with AI engineering on training methodology and validation approach * Define and own model evaluation metrics specific to weapons detection (false positive/negative rates, detection latency, throughput under real\-world load) and the standards for when a model is ready to ship * Design and run field trials with prospects and customers; use real\-world trial results for product iteration **Product \& Technical Strategy** * Collaborate closely with AI researchers and engineers to define product vision and technical roadmaps * Evaluate diverse AI models and technical approaches to select the optimal solution for specific security challenges * Analyze trade\-offs across latency, accuracy, compute cost, and hardware constraints, and make explicit decisions * Oversee feature development from early experimentation through full production deployment * Work with design and product teams to integrate AI capabilities into intuitive customer\- and operator\-facing workflows * Partner with legal/compliance on how detection performance is represented externally to customers and the market What We’re Looking For* 8\+ years of product management experience, including ownership of AI, machine learning, or computer vision products from strategy through production * Experience bringing AI or computer vision systems to production in security, safety\-critical, or other detection applications where accuracy and reliability matter * Strong understanding of AI and computer vision architectures, model evaluation, data pipelines, and technical trade\-offs * Experience defining data collection, annotation, validation, and dataset quality standards * Experience deploying and improving ML systems on physical or edge hardware * Track record of leading cross\-functional decisions across research, engineering, field operations, legal, and customer\-facing teams * Ability to translate technical complexity and business constraints into clear product decisions and priorities * Experience designing field trials and using customer and performance data to inform product and release decisions **Bonus points**: experience with regulatory/compliance considerations around representing AI performance externally; embedded or edge hardware background; time spent in physical security, public safety, or critical infrastructure. Leadership, Team Structure \& Culture You will report directly to the Chief Product Officer and operate as an individual contributor within the Product organization. This role will work closely with cross\-functional partners and require travel to customer sites and field\-trial locations to gather insights, support testing, and help translate real\-world needs into product decisions. The team's culture is high\-accountability, candid, and action\-oriented: risks are surfaced early, decisions are driven to closure, and individuals are expected to take ownership of outcomes. You will have meaningful autonomy and visibility, with the opportunity to directly influence Evolv’s product strategy and execution. Where is the role located? Our ideal candidate is based out of Evolv’s HQ in Waltham, Massachusetts, with limited flexibility for remote work. We may consider exceptional candidates who are based elsewhere. Domestic travel is expected to be approximately 25% to customer sites and field\-trial locations. Compensation and Transparency Statement The base salary range for this full\-time position is $162,000\- $258,000\. In addition to base salary, this role offers a competitive target bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and equity, in alignment with applicable state laws. Our compensation ranges are determined based on factors such as role, level, location, market benchmarks, and internal equity. The posted range represents the good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role across U.S. locations. Actual compensation within the range will be based on the candidate’s skills, experience, education, and geographic location. In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws—including those in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, New York, New Jersey, and others—we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request. We are committed to fair pay practices, and we regularly review our compensation programs to ensure they are competitive, equitable, and aligned with our values. **Benefits** At Evolv, we’re on a mission to help make public spaces safer through innovative security technology. So, we're looking for future teammates who embody our values, people who: * Do the right thing, always; * Put people first' * Own it; * Win together; and continue to * Be bold, stay curious. **Our Benefits Include**: * Equity as part of your total compensation package * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Health Savings Account (HSA) * A 401(k) plan with company match * Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)\- take the time you need to recharge, with manager approval and business needs in mind * Quarterly stipend for perks and benefits that matter most to you * Tuition reimbursement to support your ongoing learning and development * Subscription to Calm Evolv Technology (“Evolv”) is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace, and all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected by law in the locations where we operate. Evolv will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Evolv is committed to offering an inclusive and accessible experience for all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of the job application process, please connect with us at careers@evolvtechnology.com. Evolv participates in E\-verify for all employees after the completion of Form I\-9\.

jobs.title: Head of Growth Marketing
jobs.description: **About Flow** -------------- Flow Engineering is an AI\-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor. **About the role** ------------------ Flow is seeking a Head of Growth Marketing to build the demand engine behind our go\-to\-market. You will own how engineering leaders in aerospace, defense, automotive, and adjacent industries discover Flow, and you will turn that awareness into qualified pipeline. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own pipeline: set demand generation targets alongside sales and leadership, then build and run the programs to hit them. * Build a repeatable inbound motion across content, search, paid, email, and web, with honest attribution from first touch to closed won. * Run account\-based campaigns against a defined list of hardware engineering organizations, working shoulder to shoulder with founder\-led and early enterprise sales. * Develop messaging and positioning for a technical audience of systems engineers, program managers, and engineering executives, then test it until it lands. * Treat the website as a conversion surface: product pages, technical content, demo requests, and self\-serve entry points. * Own the events and field calendar, including industry conferences, customer roundtables, and webinars that reach buyers in regulated industries. * Stand up marketing operations and reporting so every program carries a cost per opportunity and a clear signal on what to cut or scale. * Partner with product and engineering on launches so new AI capabilities reach the market with a story customers actually understand. **About you** ------------- * 8\+ years in B2B marketing, including 2\+ years leading growth or demand generation, ideally taking a startup from early traction to repeatable pipeline. * Track record of owning a pipeline number and hitting it, with the reporting to show how you got there. * Experience marketing a technical product to a technical buyer. Exposure to hardware, aerospace, defense, automotive, or engineering software is a strong plus. * Comfortable with long, multi\-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and the content and nurture programs they require. * Strong writer who can turn complex engineering workflows into clear, credible copy without overclaiming. * Analytical and self\-sufficient with funnel data, experiment design, and attribution. * Comfortable in a high\-ownership, fast\-paced environment where you scope your own work and ship it. **How we work \& values** ------------------------- * Speed over everything: get campaigns live quickly, then harden and scale what works. * Own, downscope, ship, iterate: one clear owner per program, from first idea to measured result. * Fundamentals done well: measurement, attribution, and reporting are part of the first version, not an afterthought. * Competitive salary and meaningful equity. * Health, dental, and vision coverage. * Flexible time off and support for experimentation, learning, and staying current with the AI ecosystem. executive\-level communication. **What will you be doing?** --------------------------- * Partner with Account Executives on strategic opportunities, owning the technical strategy required to navigate and close complex enterprise deals. * Lead technical discovery to understand customer objectives, architecture, workflows, integrations, security requirements, and technical constraints. * Translate complex requirements into thoughtful solutions using Front’s AI capabilities, APIs, integrations, automation, and broader platform. * Design and deliver tailored product demonstrations that connect Front’s capabilities to customer use cases and measurable business outcomes. * Position Front’s AI\-powered customer service capabilities with technical and executive audiences, clearly communicating value, considerations, and limitations. * Architect and lead hands\-on AI proofs of concept and technical evaluations, defining success criteria and validating performance, feasibility, and business impact. * Serve as the technical lead for pilots and evaluations, managing technical dependencies, troubleshooting challenges, and ensuring successful outcomes. * Develop deep expertise in Front’s APIs and extensibility platform to design creative integrations with customers’ existing systems and applications. * Build credibility with Engineering, IT, Security, Operations, and Architecture technical voice in the field, raising the technical bar and mentoring other team members when appropriate. **What skills \& experience do you need?** ------------------------------------------ * **7\+ years of experience** in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a similar customer\-facing technical role, ideally within enterprise SaaS. * Proven success partnering with sales teams to navigate and win complex enterprise opportunities. * Strong experience designing and demonstrating solutions involving **AI, automation, and complex business workflows**, AI quality, performance, and impact. * Strong understanding of modern AI concepts and the ability to clearly explain their capabilities, tradeoffs, and limitations to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong technical foundation in **APIs, webhooks, authentication, data flows, integrations, and modern SaaS architectures**. * Experience working with REST APIs and independently prototyping or troubleshooting integrations. jobs.title: Assistant Professor, Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Description:** The School of Engineering and Computing at Fairfield University invites applications for a tenure\-track faculty position at the assistant professor rank in the Michael Zabinski Department of Mechanical Engineering. The start date for this position is September 1st, 2027, pending budget approval. Candidates in all areas of Mechanical Engineering or closely related fields are encouraged to apply. Position Description: This position requires an ability to perform teaching, scholarship, and service responsibilities. The successful candidate will be required to: (1\) develop and teach undergraduate and graduate courses (lecture and laboratory) in mechanical engineering. (2\) supervise Master theses, undergraduate research, capstone projects, and senior design projects; (3\) pursue scholarly activities (including externally\-funded research and peer\-reviewed publications); (4\) engage in academic advising and mentoring; and (5\) assist in program assessment, execution of the department’s continuous improvement plan, and documentation in support of ABET accreditation. The position is an academic (9\-month), tenure\-track appointment, and the salaries are competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience. The School of Engineering and Computing is organized into the Michael Zabinski Department of Mechanical Engineering, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, and the Department of Electrical, Mechatronics, and Biomedical Engineering. The Mechanical Engineering program is ABET accredited and offers Bachelor of Science and Master of Science degrees. In addition, students have an option to obtain a Concentration in either Automation, Robotics, and Manufacturing or Aerospace Engineering. The department is equipped with state\-of\-the\-art laboratories such as Material Characterization Lab, Automation, Robotics and Manufacturing (A.R.M.) Lab, Mechanical Engineering Lab, and the High\-Speed Fluids Research Lab. It also houses the Brinkman Manufacturing Laboratory and the Innovation Annex in support of teaching and research and boasts the highest undergraduate enrollment within the School of Engineering. Required Qualifications: * A Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering or closely related discipline. * Effective verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to effectively teach both undergraduate and graduate courses, including hands\-on labs. * Demonstrated potential to engage in funded research in a relevant field, along with a demonstrable publication record. jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Android (Unified Experience)
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **About the Company** Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world\-class investors, operators, and sports \& entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next\-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators. #### **The Role** You'll join the Unified Experience team — the group responsible for building seamless collector journeys across Fanatics Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, Topps, and future experiences. This is the Android seat on that team, and it's a systems role as much as a feature role. You'll own the shared Android foundation that multiple apps and multiple feature teams depend on: common identity and session handling, shared Compose components and modules, consistent navigation and deep linking between surfaces, and the migration paths that get us from where each app is today to where the unified experience needs it to be. When you get it right, four teams ship faster and collectors stop noticing the seams. The Android stack is modern by design: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose throughout, Coroutines and Flow for concurrency and state, a unidirectional architecture with a strict state contract, GraphQL against our backend, and a modular multi\-module Gradle codebase with automated build and release pipelines. No legacy View\-system app hiding under the surface — you'll be working in a codebase you can be proud of. AI tooling is part of how we work. We expect engineers to use it on the job, give it good context, and verify the output — not just accept it. #### **What You'll Do** * Design and ship shared Android foundations — reusable modules, Compose components, and internal libraries — that multiple collector\-facing apps depend on, and treat the engineers consuming them as first\-class customers. * Own unified identity, session, and entitlement flows across surfaces, so a collector signs in once and moves between Live, Instant Rips, Marketplace, and Collections without friction. * Lead migrations and consolidations against live users: persistence and data model changes, deprecating divergent implementations, and phased rollouts that don't break anyone mid\-flow. * Own features end to end — API contracts, state and effect handling, Compose UI, testing, and release. * Build deep linking, navigation, and cross\-surface handoffs that make separate products behave like one. * Write genuine test coverage: unit tests with fake dependencies, Flow and coroutine test patterns, Compose UI tests where they earn their keep — not coverage theater. * Instrument what you ship and watch it in production: event tracking, feature flags, staged Play Store rollouts, crash and ANR triage, and monitoring you actually check after launch. * Own Android performance where users feel it: startup time, jank in scrolling and animation\-heavy surfaces, memory under sustained real\-time load. * Review pull requests with judgment: surface real defects, prioritize what matters, coach on what to let go. * Contribute to architectural decisions: modularization strategy, state management, effect handling, failure handling. * Mentor engineers earlier in their career and raise the quality bar across the team. #### **What We're Looking For** * 5\+ years building consumer\-facing Android applications at scale. * Kotlin — coroutines, structured concurrency, Flow, and a working understanding of where each belongs. * Jetpack Compose — state hoisting, recomposition and stability, performance\-aware composition, Compose Navigation. * Unidirectional state management at scale — MVI or a comparable strict, testable architecture (Molecule, Orbit, Mavericks, or a well\-reasoned in\-house pattern) that you can explain and defend. * Multi\-module Gradle architecture — clean module boundaries, convention plugins, version catalogs, build times you've actively fought for. * Shared architecture across multiple apps — you've built reusable modules, SDKs, or internal libraries consumed by more than one app or more than one team, and you understand the API\-stability and versioning discipline that requires. * Dependency injection — Hilt, Dagger, Koin, or equivalent, used deliberately rather than by habit. * GraphQL on Android — Apollo Kotlin, schema\-driven development, codegen, subscriptions. * CI/CD — Bitrise, GitHub Actions, Fastlane, or equivalent automated build/test/release pipelines feeding the Play Console. * Testing discipline — JUnit, Turbine, Robolectric, Compose testing, and instrumentation tests, with real assertions. * Static analysis — ktlint, detekt, or equivalent quality gates. * Hands\-on with AI\-assisted development tooling — Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar — with a track record of using it for real work, not demos. * Structured commit/PR discipline tied to a project tracker (Linear, Jira, or equivalent). * Comfortable working across team boundaries — this role depends on influence with engineers you don't manage. #### **Bonus Points** * Experience with livestreaming, real\-time auctions, or high\-throughput WebSocket/subscription workloads. * Baseline Profiles, Macrobenchmark, or other systematic Android performance work. * Exposure to marketplace or e\-commerce Android applications. * Payments, billing, or Play Billing experience. * Developer tooling or internal platform work that measurably saved other engineers time. * Passion for sports cards, collectibles, or live commerce. *Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at* *www.fanaticsinc.com/careers* By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Today a collector can win a card in a live show, rip a pack, buy on the marketplace, and store it all in a vault — but those moments still feel like separate products. Your job is to make them feel like one. That means building the shared surfaces, APIs, and front\-end systems that connect experiences that were each built independently, and doing it without slowing any of them down. This is a hands\-on senior role. You'll own meaningful slices of the unified experience end to end — schema to API to UI — and you'll do it alongside a Staff Backend Engineer, mobile engineers, product, and design. **Why Join Us** Fanatics Collect is growing fast, and the unification work is the highest\-leverage engineering investment we have: every new app, drop, and live format gets easier once the shared foundation exists. You'll work across mobile, web, and internal tools, with real autonomy and a short path from idea to production. Your teammates are passionate about the space and most of them are collectors themselves. **Product Context and Scale** Our surfaces reach millions of collectors across iOS, Android, and web, with live, high\-traffic moments (breaks, drops, auctions closing) that make performance and reliability non\-negotiable. You'll be working in a landscape of multiple existing products with real users and real data, so migration, backward compatibility, and careful rollout are part of the craft. **First 90 Days** * Ship a meaningful, user\-facing piece of the unified experience end to end. * Build a working map of how Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, and Topps actually fit together today — data models, identity, entitlements, and the seams between them. * Establish working relationships with the backend, mobile, product, and design partners you'll depend on. * Identify one piece of duplicated or divergent logic across surfaces and make the case for consolidating it. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain fullstack features using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, and TypeScript. * Build scalable, performant, highly available services and interfaces on AWS and Vercel. * Own features end to end: data model, API contract, front\-end implementation, tests, rollout, and post\-launch metrics. * Build and maintain reusable front\-end components, APIs, and shared libraries that multiple apps (web and mobile) depend on — and treat other engineers as first\-class consumers of what you build. * Contribute to cross\-surface concerns like shared identity, entitlements, inventory, and navigation between collector experiences. * Ship behind feature flags with instrumentation in place, and use the resulting data to decide what to keep, fix, or cut. * Prototype quickly with Product and Design when a working demo will settle a debate faster than a document. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, LLM\-backed workflows) to raise your own throughput, and share what works with the team. * Write meaningful tests across the stack — unit, integration, and E2E — using Playwright, Jest, React Testing Library, and Pytest, and keep CI/CD pipelines trustworthy. * Maintain component documentation and interaction specs via Storybook. * Participate in sprint planning, retros, and product strategy sessions; raise scope and sequencing concerns early rather than at the end. * Mentor engineers through code review and pairing, and raise the bar on code structure, testing, and documentation. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of professional fullstack development experience, with demonstrated proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Python, plus hands\-on cloud experience (AWS preferred). * Strong grasp of architectural patterns, API design, and application performance tuning — and the judgment to know when a simpler solution is the right one. * Track record of owning features end to end in production, including the parts after launch: monitoring, debugging, and iterating on real user behavior. * Solid front\-end fundamentals: responsive UI development, accessibility (a11y), and front\-end performance practices. * Experience with state management patterns and tools such as React Context, Zustand, Redux, or XState, and a thoughtful approach to complexity in large apps. * Strong testing discipline with tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Pytest. * Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices. * Comfortable working across domains — backend APIs, customer\-facing web, mobile web, and internal tools — and context switching without dropping threads. * Clear written and verbal communication; able to work directly with Product, Design, and other engineering teams and drive alignment on your own work. * Experience using or a genuine appetite for AI developer tooling to improve velocity. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have** * Experience integrating or consolidating multiple existing products, including data migrations against live users. * Experience with high\-traffic, real\-time, or live\-event product surfaces. * Background in growth engineering or rapid experimentation frameworks. * Experience in e\-commerce, marketplaces, or gaming live ops. * Design system or shared component library ownership. * Passion for collecting, trading, sports, or gaming — and an interest in being a user of what you build. If you like owning problems end to end, care about how software feels and not just whether it works, and want your work used daily by millions of collectors — we'd love to talk. *Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at* *www.fanaticsinc.com/careers* By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. **About the Role** Fivetran and dbt Labs is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. As a member of the Site Reliability Engineering team, you will take ownership of the overall performance and reliability of Fivetran's infrastructure, the robustness of the deployment pipeline, as well as timely and effective incident response and resolution.
