jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT GREENBOARD** At Greenboard, we're building the future of financial compliance. Greenboard is the unified, AI\-native compliance operating system for RIAs, fintechs, private funds, hedge funds, and more. It replaces the fragmented mix of legacy tools and automates more than previously possible. By centralizing data and workflows, Greenboard helps firms reduce regulatory risk, simplify their technology stack, modernize how they run compliance, and save money. Our founding team includes engineers who have scaled products at Amazon, Google, and multiple unicorn startups. We're backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Base10, and other top\-tier investors, and have raised over $20M to date. Brand\-name financial institutions already rely on Greenboard, and we're growing fast. **ABOUT THE ROLE** You'll be our first dedicated Automation engineer. Our customers are regulated financial institutions, which means a missed bug is not just a bad user experience. It can mean an incomplete books\-and\-records archive, a marketing review that never routed for approval, or an attestation that quietly failed to send. Quality is part of the product we sell. You'll own how we test: the framework, the automated suites, and the release process, built from scratch and then embedded with the engineers who ship. You'll also help us solve something most automation engineers have never had to solve, which is how to test AI systems whose output is not deterministic. There is no existing playbook here. If you like defining the standard rather than enforcing someone else's, this is the seat. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN** * **The foundation.** Test framework, automated regression suites, and QA practices built from zero, with your call on tooling * **The critical paths.** Message archiving and supervision, marketing review routing, employee attestations, and audit trails, which are the flows that cannot break * **Testing the AI.** How we evaluate AI\-driven detection and review, including golden datasets and quality bars for output that is not deterministic * **Data integrity at scale.** End\-to\-end validation from ingestion of tens of millions of messages a day through to what a compliance officer sees on screen * **The release gate.** Bug triage, release sign\-off, and the definition of deployment\-ready at Greenboard **WHO ARE YOU?** * Love to move fast and build things * Looking for deep ownership over the quality of everything we ship * Obsess over the customers you're building for * An excellent communicator * Value collaboration * Located in NYC **QUALIFICATIONS** * 3\+ years testing software where being wrong has consequences beyond a bad review: fintech, healthtech, payments, or anywhere an audit followed a bug * Able to test a system you cannot fully see from the UI. Comfortable with REST APIs and querying the database directly, because verifying a feature here means checking what landed and what the retention policy did with it, not just what rendered * Write Playwright or Cypress suites that survive a redesign, with opinions about selectors, fixtures, and what belongs in an integration test versus an end\-to\-end one * Can read a feature spec and name the states nobody thought about: the employee who left mid\-attestation, the message that arrives out of order, the marketing piece edited after approval * Have held a release before, explained why to someone who wanted it out, and been right **NICE TO HAVE** * Tested a system where output is not deterministic and had to define correct as a threshold rather than an exact match * Worked in a Node JS and React codebase on AWS, or debugged a queue\-based ingestion pipeline * Been through a SOC 2 audit and know what evidence a test suite can produce for one * Sat with a compliance officer, an advisor, or a back\-office team and watched them work * Interest in the financial industry is a plus, but not necessary **BENEFITS** * 401(k) with 5% company match * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * 15 days PTO \+ 11 company holidays \+ flexible sick time * 2 additional PTO days for each year of service (up to 10 additional days) * 10 remote days per year plus additional around the holidays * Bi\-annual off\-sites and team retreats * Front\-row seat to building the operating backbone of modern finance Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Data & Analytics
jobs.description: **About Us** Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care. We deliver high\-touch, relationship\-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care. We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations. Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors. **About The Role** We're hiring our first dedicated data person. This person will build on our existing data platform, harden it to ensure consistent performance and build upon our metric library to ensure that our operators can monitor performance across all of our levers. Success in this role means end to end ownership, from data platform to metric delivery and visualization in dashboarding tools As Data and Analytics Engineer, you own four things: * **The analytics layer**: the dbt models and business logic that turn raw data into something usable, and the metric definitions underneath them * **Reporting and BI**: the reporting layer the whole business reads from * **Our production systems**: you take ownership of systems as they come in\-house from our engineering partner, harden them, and keep making them better, with accountability for uptime \& system integrity * **The partnership with our engineering team**: you are the internal counterpart who knows both the business and the systems well enough to resolve most issues directly This is a build\-and\-own role. Our engineering partner stands up a new capability; you take it on once it is live, harden it, and keep improving it. You work as their peer rather than their coordinator. You also partner closely with the pop health team (who owns our value drivers) in defining metrics and deciding together what the business needs to see. You report to the VP of Growth and Population Health. **Location:** New York City strongly preferred (Hybrid). Open to exceptional remote candidates. **What You'll Do** Own the Analytics Layer * Build and maintain the dbt models and business logic our metrics and workflows depend on. Work within Google Cloud to iterate on our business logic and transformation infrastructure * Ensure consistency in definitions across all surfaces at Greenbrook * Work with the performance managers on what needs measuring and what good looks like in their areas Take Ownership of What's in Production * Take on systems as they move from our engineering partner into steady state, and keep them healthy * Be accountable for uptime \& system integrity – catch ingestion and pipeline issues or logic bugs and resolve them within our SLAs. Develop monitoring and uptime reporting. * Ensure a performant system. Optimize workloads and runtime * Keep improving what you take on rather than only maintaining it Partner Across the Business * Be the counterpart our engineering partner can hand production work to, resolving what you can and escalating what needs them * Build dashboards to support organizational decisionmaking * Work closely with the business – sit in the operating meetings where the data gets used, so you know what decisions it feeds **What Success Looks Like** * Data Trust: the business trusts the numbers, and you are ahead of issues rather than behind them * Reliability: systems transitioned to you stay healthy, and when they break they get fixed quickly * Coverage: the metrics our drivers depend on have a certified definition and a single source of truth * Delivery: the work you committed to for the quarter shipped * Metrics you'll own: delivery against committed quarterly work, and counterpart satisfaction among the performance managers and the Head of Population Health **About You** You bring: * Fluency in dbt and Python * Hands on experience with Health care datasets and interoperability frameworks which our business run on, including a deep understanding of claims, eligibility, EHR data, and frameworks such as FHIR and HL7 * A solid grasp of business fundamentals, enough to partner with business and clinical managers on defining metrics rather than only building to spec * Experience owning production systems, including being the person who responds when something breaks * Bachelor's degree required * A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork You'll stand out if you: * **Want to own a system deeply**: you would rather take something into production, harden it, and keep improving it than move on to the next greenfield build * **Get to root cause**: you find out why a number is wrong rather than patching the symptom * **Are AI\-native**: you live in modern AI tools to support your work * **Communicate with clarity**: you are comfortable explaining complex data to business users and communicate proactively * **Own the outcome**: high bias for action, follow through on commitments, and close loops without needing to be chased **Why You'll Love Working Here** **Make An Impact Every Day** Be part of a mission\-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare. **Work That Actually Matters** We're not a volume\-driven system, we're accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered. **Build And Grow With Us** We're building more than a company, we're building careers. As we expand, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges. **Strong, Transparent Compensation \& Benefits** * $170,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications * Generous annual performance bonus * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid time off * 401(k) with company match **Our Selection Process** Application Initial interview Skills/experience interview Values interview Case Study and Case Study Interview References **Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity** At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We do this through a culture of respect and belonging, ensuring our teammates feel cared for first and foremost. We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

jobs.title: Director, Forward-Deployed AI Solutions
jobs.description: **ROLE OVERVIEW** As a forward\-deployed AI operator within Real\-World Data Solutions (RWDS), you will work at the intersection of people, process, data, and technology to turn messy operational challenges into AI\-enabled systems that perform in daily work. You will embed directly with the teams doing the work: observing how workflows actually operate, identifying the right intervention, building the smallest useful solution, testing it with real users, and improving it until it delivers measurable value. Sometimes that solution will use AI; sometimes deterministic automation, an existing platform, or a process redesign will be the better answer. Your job is to make that judgment and own the outcome. This is a senior, hands\-on builder role for an operations\-minded problem solver—not a traditional software engineering position. You should be comfortable building with modern AI, automation, analytics, and low\-code tools, while partnering with data and engineering teams when a solution requires production\-grade infrastructure. Because this role sits at the center of how RWDS delivers for clients, the work you do here should show up in two core ways: how clients experience working with us, and how profitably we operate **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Discover and document how work actually happens: the people, approvals, exceptions, and informal tools (spreadsheets, Slack threads, workarounds) that fill the gaps in official process * Build and ship AI\-enabled tools, workflows, and automations directly with the analysts and teams who'll use them * Own your tools past the demo stage — make sure the underlying data logic is sound and the tool holds up as usage scales, partnering with engineering to productionize and incorporate into enterprise tooling * Use current AI/LLM tooling (agents, RAG, coding assistants) to build faster, and know when a lightweight tool or application is the right call versus when it needs to be a real engineered solution * Design appropriate human review, exception handling, monitoring, and governance into each solution from the beginning * Actively gather voice\-of\-client feedback from analysts and business stakeholders to determine what should be built * Pilot new tools with a small group of real users before scaling team\-wide, and use that feedback to shape the broader rollout * Communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to non\-technical stakeholders * Take ownership of a defined portion of the AI/tooling roadmap for RWDS with minimal oversight — you're expected to drive, not just execute against someone else's plan * Train the RWDS and dependent teams on AI tooling and maintain ongoing communication to support adoption **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required** * Ability to understand data structures, trace data through a workflow, validate business logic, and collaborate effectively with analysts and engineers * Track record of driving a project or initiative from ambiguous problem to shipped solution with real adoption, without needing heavy oversight * Demonstrated experience with LLM\-based tools and practical AI integration patterns * Understanding of responsible AI and data governance in a regulated industry * Able to recognize when a lightweight solution is appropriate—and when security, scale, data complexity, or reliability requires engineering partnership * Strong communication skills — able to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders and turn a vague business ask into a scoped technical plan **Preferred** * Analytics/data engineering, or ETL background, or equivalent depth working directly with large relational databases (SQL, Python, Databricks, or equivalent) * Experience building playbooks, training programs, or enablement materials that scaled technology adoption across a team * Some prior leadership or informal mentorship experience — this role is expected to grow into more ownership over time * Experience evaluating or piloting new AI platforms and tools, and making a real build\-vs\-buy call rather than just experimenting * Exposure to complex analytics workflows leveraging large data environments * Familiarity with real\-world healthcare data (claims, EHR, labs, registries, or similar patient\-level datasets) and how it's used in life sciences work We welcome portfolios, capstone projects, workflow maps, automation examples, or case studies that demonstrate how you diagnosed a problem, chose an approach, built and deployed a solution, earned user adoption, and measured the result. jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.description: **Love building new things—but also get a weird amount of satisfaction from tracking down the one plugin, line of code or integration causing everything to misbehave? Hiebing is looking for a curious and resourceful Web Developer who’s excited to build smart digital experiences, solve unfamiliar problems and keep growing alongside a collaborative team. WordPress will be at the center of the role, but your work—and your opportunity to make an impact—will extend well beyond it.** Hiebing is seeking a curious, motivated and innovative Web Developer who is eager to build intelligent solutions in a fast\-paced, collaborative team environment. Our team values learning, support and innovation, creating a culture where developers can grow, contribute and have fun doing great work. WordPress development and maintenance will be at the center of this role, but we’re looking for someone who is equally energized by troubleshooting an integration, helping implement tagging, debugging an email or figuring out something they haven’t encountered before. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter who is curious, resourceful and motivated to find answers independently. They see unfamiliar challenges as opportunities to learn rather than barriers and are comfortable moving between different types of digital work as client and team needs evolve. This role will initially be divided between new WordPress development and maintenance for existing clients, with the potential to create new capabilities and offerings for our clients and eventually lead the WordPress development practice at Hiebing. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop, enhance and maintain WordPress websites, including block editor/Gutenberg development, theme customization, plugin configuration and integrations. * Troubleshoot and resolve website issues, including plugin conflicts, third\-party integrations, browser and device inconsistencies, and performance problems. * Support ongoing website maintenance, landing pages, forms, content migrations and other digital enhancements across multiple client properties. * Assist with analytics and tagging implementations using tools such as Google Tag Manager and GA4, including implementation, troubleshooting and QA. * Support email development and production needs, including building and modifying HTML emails, troubleshooting rendering or template issues, and conducting technical QA. * Implement and troubleshoot marketing technology integrations, including forms, analytics, consent management, email platforms and other third\-party tools. * Work within Git\-based development workflows and follow established practices for commits, branching, pull requests, releases and documentation. * Collaborate with developers, digital strategists, project managers, designers and other team members to solve problems and deliver high\-quality work. * Maintain security, accessibility, performance and quality standards across development work. **Required Skills and Experience** ---------------------------------- * 2–3 years of professional web development experience, with meaningful hands\-on WordPress theme development experience. * Comfort using GitHub Copilot for AI\-assisted development and as part of the problem\-solving process. * Strong HTML, CSS and JavaScript fundamentals. * Working knowledge of PHP and WordPress development. * Experience with WordPress themes, plugins, Gutenberg/block editor and common marketing\-site integrations. * Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills. * Experience working with Git\-based version control. * Ability and willingness to work across different types of technical assignments rather than specializing exclusively in one area. * Resourceful and comfortable researching unfamiliar problems and identifying solutions independently. * Self\-motivated, with the ability to take ownership of work and follow it through to completion. * Curious and eager to learn new technologies, platforms and approaches. * Familiarity with analytics, tagging and marketing integrations, including GA4/GTM, consent tools, A/B testing, email providers and CDPs. * Accessibility awareness, including WCAG fundamentals, and experience implementing accessible UI patterns. * Able to manage multiple priorities and shift between projects in a fast\-paced environment. * Collaborative, dependable and committed to producing high\-quality work. **Nice\-to\-Have Skills and Qualifications** -------------------------------------------- * WooCommerce or Shopify experience, including checkout optimization, payment and shipping plugins, and catalog organization. * Comfort with WP\-CLI, Composer, deployment automation and modern WordPress build pipelines. * Experience implementing WordPress hardening practices, including secure configuration, plugin governance and least\-privilege access. * Familiarity with unit testing or automated regression testing. * Hands\-on experience with Email on Acid or Litmus to create visual and brand consistency across email devices and clients. **You’ll Thrive Here If…** -------------------------- * You enjoy building new digital experiences—and making existing ones work better. * You see an unfamiliar technical problem as something to investigate, not something to avoid. * You’re willing to dig into documentation, test possible solutions and ask thoughtful questions when needed. * You can move comfortably between development, maintenance, troubleshooting, analytics, tagging and email work. * You take ownership of your work and care about seeing it through from initial request to final QA. * You balance speed with thoughtful attention to security, accessibility, performance and quality. * You’re curious about AI and emerging technology while still bringing your own judgment and problem\-solving skills to the work. * You believe the strongest solutions come from developers, strategists, designers and project managers working together. **Where You’ll Work** --------------------- This position is based in Hiebing’s Madison, Wisconsin office. Collaboration is an important part of how we work at Hiebing. This position follows our hybrid work model, which includes working from the Madison office each Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, with the option to work remotely Thursday and Friday. Candidates who do not currently live within commuting distance should be willing to relocate to the Madison area. **Why Hiebing?** ---------------- At Hiebing, you’ll work alongside smart, kind and incredibly talented people who genuinely enjoy making each other’s ideas better. You’ll collaborate across disciplines, support regional and national brands and have the opportunity to build digital experiences that matter—for our clients, their audiences and each other. We’re a place where curiosity is celebrated, craftsmanship is respected and thoughtful judgment is just as valuable as bold ideas. We believe in speaking in data, Dreaming in Color and never settling for the expected. You’ll be challenged to grow, encouraged to explore new technologies and supported by teammates who believe the best work is always built together. We’re insight\-driven ideamakers who give a damn—about the work, our clients and one another. Our We Before Me philosophy reminds us that the strongest work is never about one person; it’s about what we build together. If you’re someone who enjoys solving problems, sharing what you learn and using technology to create smarter, more meaningful experiences, you’ll feel right at home here. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Hybrid work environment with the option to work remotely Thursday and Friday * Competitive medical, dental and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match and profit sharing * Paid parental leave * Generous paid time off, including your birthday off * Professional development funding and ongoing learning opportunities * Opportunities to give back through meaningful pro bono work and community involvement * Investment and partnership opportunities * Dog\-friendly office * A culture built around curiosity, collaboration and our We Before Me philosophy **Work Authorization** ---------------------- Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship. Wireshark, Microsoft Network Monitor, tcpdump, pktmon, netsh trace, tshark, WinDump, etc. + Other DevOps Experience. * **3 Years of Coding and Automation experience.** + Experience working across the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) in Agile development environments. + Experience implementing and integrating RESTful APIs. + Proficiency in **C\#** + Proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python + POWERSHELL ( **required** ). * 1\-3 years of **Relational Database Experience**SQL Server , MySQL, PostgreSQL + * **Ability to work 24/7 on\-call rotation as needed with 2 others** **WE VALUE** * Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field. * **OnGuard Experience** : operating, administering, or configuring. * **Windows Patching** : Patching, configuring, securing, maintaining. * 2\+ years of understanding of systems development lifecycle from conception to delivery (mostly a Kanban framework.). * Experience working in IoT environments and connected\-device ecosystems. * **Soft Skills** : + Problem solving/trouble shooting. + Innovation. + Collaboration + Documentation Experience in 24/7 online environment + "The annual base salary range for this posit d Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. Job Posting Date: 9/9/2026 **ABOUT HONEYWELL** Honeywell International Inc. (Nasdaq: HON) invents and commercializes technologies that address some of the world's most critical challenges around energy, safety, security, productivity, and global urbanization. This position collaborates closely with cross\-functional teams to understand solution requirements, assess technical needs, and deliver solutions that improve business outcomes for customers and partners within specified release timelines. This is a role for someone who brings a curious, solutions\-oriented mindset — thriving on translating business needs into thoughtful technical configurations and contributing to a collaborative, high\-performing engineering team. **Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.** ------------------------------------------------------ * Participate in the review and understanding of industry use cases — collaborating with team members on technical requirements and design documents to facilitate effective solution designs and configurations of moderately complex solution logic. * Configure moderately complex software solutions to meet specific business needs — ensuring alignment with functional requirements and contributing to the team's shared knowledge base around solution design and implementation best practices. * Perform initial testing of moderately complex solution configurations — ensuring they meet specified requirements and thoroughly documenting testing criteria for the quality assurance team to follow. * Provide support to customers and partners as part of early adoption programs — assisting with setup and deployment of solutions, basic troubleshooting, gathering feedback, and ensuring a positive user experience during the early stages of product deployment. * Triage and prioritize non\-critical software defects reported by the technical support team — ensuring timely resolution and effective communication with relevant stakeholders. * Participate and provide feedback as part of solution peer reviews — contributing to a culture of quality, continuous improvement, and shared technical excellence across the team. **Role Essentials** ------------------- * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, with experience in configuring, designing, and deploying software — and familiarity with relevant programming, database, and cloud technologies. * Good oral and written communication skills — demonstrating a professional demeanor and the ability to interact with others with discretion and tact at all levels of the organization. * Good organizational, multi\-tasking, and time management skills — with good facilitation and project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment. * Good collaboration, interpersonal, and analytical skills — able to maintain solid rapport with team members and professionalism with those outside of the department, with good data gathering and problem\-solving abilities. * Self\-motivated with the ability to learn and adapt to new technologies, frameworks, and development processes — taking on tasks independently, seeking guidance as necessary, and managing projects to completion with oversight, with up to **5% travel** time required. **What We'd Like to See** ------------------------- * Ability to use original thinking to translate goals into the implementation of new ideas and design solutions — with a demonstrated ability to influence, motivate, and mobilize team members and business partners. * Good ability to develop and use engaging, informative, and compelling presentation methodologies — with a good ability to establish rapport and gain the trust of others, effective at gaining consensus among stakeholders. * Good knowledge of systems administration and Microsoft Operating Systems and products — with strong Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team environment. * Good ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and tact — with strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality in all aspects of solution design and delivery. * Demonstrated ability to contribute to team shared knowledge base repositories — supporting best practices around solution design, implementation, and peer review processes. * Knowledge of Healthcare IT * Knowledge of Healthcare Business Processes * Experience with AI Technologies **Pay Transparency** -------------------- The base salary compensation range for this role is **$101,121 – $118,161 per year**. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job\-related factors in accordance with applicable laws. **About Hyland** ---------------- Hyland is the pioneer of the Content Innovation Cloud™, delivering ubiquitous enterprise intelligence to organizations with solutions that unlock actionable insights and drive automation. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Research
jobs.description: **Location:** San Francisco (In\-Person) OR New York (In\-Person, with an initial 3–6 month rotation in SF) **About the Role:** We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who builds like a core systems engineer and communicates like a peer to elite researchers. You will embed directly with technical teams at customer organizations—working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with their machine learning engineers, researchers, and infrastructure leads—to architect, code, and deploy complex AI agent systems into production. This is not a traditional solutions engineering or technical account management role. jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- Intel's Advanced Packaging Technology and Manufacturing (APTM) organization is seeking a highly motivated **Data** **Scientist,** **Semiconductor** **Manufacturing** **Analytics** to drive data\-driven innovation across Thermal Compression Bonding (TCB), advanced packaging, process control, yield improvement, and manufacturing optimization. In this role, you will partner with process, equipment, metrology, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to develop advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI\-based solutions that improve manufacturing performance, process stability, and product yield. You will apply statistical methodologies, predictive modeling, and large\-scale data analysis to solve complex manufacturing challenges and accelerate decision\-making across Intel's advanced packaging operations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys translating complex technical problems into scalable analytical solutions that deliver measurable business impact. **Key Responsibilities but not limited to:** -------------------------------------------- * Analyze manufacturing, process, equipment, metrology, and yield data to identify trends, correlations, anomalies, and root causes of process variation. * Develop and validate data analytics and machine learning models to support: process monitoring, excursion detection, yield prediction, defect pattern analysis and tool health / process drift monitoring. * Build proof\-of\-concepts to demonstrate the technical feasibility of predictive analytics and ML\-based methods for TCB and related manufacturing applications. * Work with process and equipment teams to define analytics requirements and translate manufacturing problems into scalable data solutions. * Support advanced process control initiatives. * Collaborate with manufacturing stakeholders to deploy practical solutions that can be used in production environments. * Develop dashboards, reports, and automated analysis tools to improve decision\-making and reaction time. Maintain a strong focus on data quality, model validity, and manufacturing relevance. * **Behavioral traits that we are looking for:** * Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills with the ability to solve complex technical and manufacturing challenges. * The ability to make sound technical decisions with limited or ambiguous information while clearly communicating assumptions, risks, and recommendations. * A strong ownership mindset and demonstrated ability to drive initiatives from concept through implementation. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex analytical concepts into actionable business and engineering decisions. * Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills across technical and operational organizations. * Technical leadership and the ability to influence decisions without direct authority. * Adaptability and resilience in fast\-paced manufacturing environments with evolving priorities. * A continuous improvement mindset and passion for leveraging data, AI, and machine learning to solve challenging problems. Strong attention to detail while maintaining focus on broader business and manufacturing objectives. * Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life. * See Intel Benefits for more details. **Qualifications:** ------------------- **Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.** -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Note:** **For information on Intel’s immigration sponsorship guidelines, please see** **Intel U.S. Immigration Sponsorship Information** **Minimum Qualifications and Experience:** ------------------------------------------ Bachelor's degree with 6\+ years of experience, Master's degree with 4\+ years of experience, or PhD with 2\+ years of experience in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Operations Research, or a related technical discipline. In addition, you must have 2\+ years of experience in the following; * Experience in manufacturing data analysis, statistical analysis, and applying data\-driven methods to solve process or yield problems. * Python programming and JMP for data analysis, automation, and model development. * Experience working with large datasets from manufacturing, equipment, metrology, or quality systems. * Apply AI/ML, statistical methods, or predictive modeling to extract actionable insights and support business or engineering decisions. * SQL or other database query tools for data extraction and analysis. **Preferred Qualifications and Experience:** -------------------------------------------- * Experience in semiconductor manufacturing, preferably assembly / advanced packaging. * Understanding of advanced process control (APC), including run\-to\-run control, SPC, excursion detection, and process monitoring. * Experience with yield analysis, process capability improvement, and root cause investigation in a manufacturing environment. * Familiarity with machine learning models for anomaly detection, prediction, clustering, or classification. * Experience developing dashboards, reports, or analysis tools. * Experience working with computer vision or automated inspection data is a plus. * Previous related work experience in a semiconductor foundry preferred **Why** **Intel** ----------------- At Intel Foundry, you'll help solve some of the industry's most complex manufacturing challenges using advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. jobs.title: Principal, AI Security
jobs.description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron, Inc. (NASDAQ: ITRI) is a global leader in technology and services dedicated to the resourceful use of energy and water. With more than 300 million connected endpoints deployed worldwide, Itron is one of the world's largest and most successful IoT companies. Through innovative technology, software, and services, we help utilities and cities improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experiences, and build a more resourceful and sustainable future. As we accelerate adoption of artificial intelligence across our enterprise, products, and services, we are seeking an exceptional security leader to help shape and secure the future of AI at Itron.**Role Summary** The Principal, AI Security Architecture \& Engineering serves as Itron's senior technical authority for AI security. This highly visible, hands\-on leadership role is responsible for defining and implementing the security architecture, governance controls, engineering standards, and operational practices that enable safe, scalable adoption of artificial intelligence, generative AI, machine learning, and AI agents across the enterprise and product portfolio. The ideal candidate combines deep cybersecurity expertise with practical experience securing modern AI ecosystems, including autonomous and semi\-autonomous agents, large language models, AI platforms, model gateways, non\-human identities, and data access controls. This individual will partner closely with Information Security, Product Security, Legal, Privacy, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, and business leaders to help drive innovative AI capabilities while protecting customers, products, data, and intellectual property.**Duties \& Responsibilities** ------------------------------ * Define and lead Itron's enterprise AI security strategy, architecture, policies, standards, reference architectures, and multi\-year roadmap. * Design and implement security controls across the AI and agent lifecycle, including registration, inventory management, identity governance, credential protection, authorization boundaries, autonomy controls, human oversight checkpoints, memory isolation, and agent decommissioning. * Establish scalable security guardrails for generative AI platforms, model integrations, APIs, plugins, automation workflows, AI assistants, and emerging agentic ecosystems. * Develop and maintain governance controls supporting privacy, confidentiality, data protection, transparency, explainability, accountability, ethical AI use, and bias mitigation. * Lead AI\-focused threat modeling, adversarial testing, security reviews, and risk assessments for enterprise and customer\-facing solutions. * Evaluate and mitigate emerging AI threats, including prompt injection, tool misuse, privilege escalation, AI supply chain compromise, context poisoning, insecure agent interactions, and rogue agent behavior. * Partner with engineering, product, and architecture teams to embed secure\-by\-design principles into the development, deployment, testing, and operation of AI\-enabled systems. * Advance the use of AI within Cybersecurity by designing and piloting AI\-assisted capabilities that improve detection engineering, threat hunting, vulnerability management, alert triage, evidence collection, and operational effectiveness. * Define security logging, telemetry, monitoring, alerting, and reporting requirements that measure AI control effectiveness and detect anomalous or malicious activity. * Develop and operate AI Security Posture Management capabilities, including inventories, risk assessments, third\-party evaluations, incident response processes, compliance readiness, and ongoing monitoring. * Conduct security assessments of AI vendors, platforms, and service providers with emphasis on architecture, data handling, privacy, access controls, resiliency, and operational risk. * Provide technical leadership and guidance for AI\-related incidents, investigations, governance decisions, policy exceptions, and risk acceptance reviews. * Author clear technical standards, reference architectures, implementation guidance, and executive communications that enable responsible and secure AI adoption. * Mentor engineers, architects, and security practitioners while fostering a collaborative, customer\-centric culture that balances innovation with risk management. * Stay current on evolving AI technologies, industry regulations, attack techniques, and emerging security best practices, translating insights into actionable improvements for Itron. **Required Skills \& Experience** --------------------------------- * 7\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, identity and access management, application security, product security, or a related technical discipline.  a protection, logging, monitoring, and third\-party integrations. * Proven experience conducting threat modeling, architecture reviews, security assessments, control validations, and cyber risk evaluations. * Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, least privilege, secure software design principles, and modern security architectures. * Ability to analyze complex AI and cybersecurity risks and communicate practical recommendations to both technical and business leaders. * Exceptional written, verbal, facilitation, and stakeholder\-management skills. * Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across diverse teams while driving accountability, collaboration, and execution in a fast\-changing technology environment. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. **Preferred Skills \& Experience** ---------------------------------- * Experience securing large\-scale deployments of frontier AI models through direct provider APIs, Microsoft Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, model gateways, or comparable enterprise AI platforms. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Foundry Agent Service, Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations, AI gateway technologies, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Vertex AI, Databricks AI capabilities, ChatGPT Enterprise, or similar platforms. * Familiarity with AI security and governance frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, MITRE ATLAS, ISO/IEC 42001, and AI regulatory readiness initiatives. * Experience performing AI red teaming, adversarial testing, prompt injection testing, abuse\-case development, or AI deployment readiness assessments. * Background in secure software development, DevSecOps, CI/CD security, container security, software supply chain security, or product security architecture reviews. * Experience operating in regulated industries or environments aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR, CMMC, critical infrastructure, utilities, or similar compliance frameworks. * Professional certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, Microsoft Security certifications, cloud security certifications, AI governance certifications, AI security certifications, or equivalent credentials. **Travel:** Less than 25% on average**Benefits Info:** This position also includes a competitive benefit package including; financial, social, health and wellbeing programs, paid vacation, 401k matching, employee stock purchase program, hybrid work schedule, and more! The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience and may vary by location. The base salary is $96,000\-165,000 annually. This position is eligible for our annual bonus program. \#LI\-EP1 Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1\-800\-635\-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com. Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II, Customer Experience
jobs.description: Kard is building commerce media infrastructure that connects financial institutions, financial\-services platforms, and merchants through data and merchant\-funded rewards. As our reach expands, we are building for a step\-change in scale, and for opportunities ranging from more relevant rewards and marketer intelligence to new commerce and distribution models. ### **About the Role** The Customer Experience (CX) team owns the systems that power Kard's end\-to\-end rewards experience: transaction matching and the cellar pipeline, offer ingestion and delivery (including partner integrations like Rewards Network and SEATED), the cell\-based routing architecture, and the Support API that keeps our internal and partner\-facing tooling running. As a Senior Software Engineer II, you'll operate at the center of this — designing and building the services that ingest, match, and settle transactions at scale, while helping the team raise its bar on operational readiness, testing, and documentation. This role reports into the CX engineering team, with a strong focus on our issuer and partner\-facing surface area, working alongside Support, Design, and Product through Kard's Shape Up\-based pitch cycle. You'll drive pitches end\-to\-end, participate in on\-call, and help the team keep pace with a fast\-growing transaction volume and issuer surface. ### **Responsibilities** * Architect and build scalable services across transaction matching, the cellar pipeline, and offer ingestion — new work defaults to Go and Postgres; existing services are a mix of TypeScript and MongoDB. * Own features end\-to\-end through Kard's Shape Up cycle: discovery, pitch writing, implementation, testing, and production rollout, including a written launch/rollback plan for anything touching transaction or offer data. * Actively participate in on\-call, incident response, and IOC (interrupt/on\-call) triage; drive root\-cause fixes rather than one\-off patches (e.g., ingestion validation gaps, UID/timestamp mismatches, Datadog alert coverage). * Strengthen our issuer/client\-facing APIs and SDKs — reliability, clarity, and self\-service — so partners and Support can resolve more issues independently, reducing engineering escalations. * Lead by example: make decisive technical calls and foster collaboration across Product, Design, and Engineering to keep the team moving toward CX's strategic goals. * Champion enhancements to our tech stack, methodologies, and standards — authentication, rate limiting, deployment, observability, error handling, and test coverage (unit, integration, end\-to\-end) — with an eye toward resilience, agility, and quality, not just shipping speed. * Mentor engineers, contribute to design and architecture discussions, and help the team consolidate or deprecate legacy/overlapping services rather than letting them accumulate. * Write clear documentation and playbooks (local dev setup, deployment, troubleshooting) so ownership doesn't stay concentrated with one or two people. ### **Desired Skills** * Expert programming skills in Go and/or TypeScript, with experience building scalable, secure, high\-performance backend services. * Solid experience with distributed systems, event\-driven architectures (SQS, Temporal), and both relational and document databases (Postgres and MongoDB). * Proficiency with AWS and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform), including container technologies (Kubernetes/EKS) and serverless components (Lambda). * Experience working on transaction\-processing, matching, or ingestion pipelines where correctness and idempotency matter. * Comfort leading a technical project from discovery through production rollout, including writing clear specs and driving cross\-team collaboration (e.g., with Support, Data, or partner integration teams). * Skilled with agentic software development — using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) to plan and implement complex features, not just autocomplete — while still owning the design and quality of the result. * Commitment to fostering an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture. * U.S. core business hours availability and willingness to travel for company meetings. ### **Bonus Points** * Experience with card\-linked offers, loyalty, fintech, or another transaction\-intensive marketplace. * Experience with partner data ingestion (file\-based or API) and the validation/monitoring needed to run it reliably in production. * Familiarity with Cognito\-based auth, API gateway enforcement (e.g., Envoy), or claims\-based authorization. * Experience with Databricks or a similar data platform, and with migrating services from a legacy stack (e.g., Databricks to Postgres/Lakebase) without disrupting production. * Contributions to the tech community or open\-source projects. * Past success in startup settings, and a track record of empathy, collaboration, and productivity in remote work. ### **Compensation** * **United States:** $160,000 \- $190,000 USD * **Argentina:** $120,000 \- $140,000 USD **Why Join:** Kard recognizes the unique value each of us brings to our collective success. As part of our remote\-first team, you'll have the autonomy to influence our trajectory, actively contributing to the growth of our business and the evolution of our company culture. By embodying our core values of Initiative, Openness, and Humility, you will not only witness but directly foster an inclusive and dynamic work environment, from the executive level down. Our competitive benefit plan includes: * Flexible PTO, with a minimum requirement to take one day off a quarter, ten days a year, promoting mental well\-being * Observance of 11 Federal Holidays, plus an additional day each for Black Friday and Christmas Eve (US employees only) * Health, Dental and Vision Insurance * 401k with employer match (US employees only) * Coworking space and WFH setup reimbursement * Company Offsites for planning, team\-building, and networking Kard is an equal opportunity employer and we actively encourage applicants of all genders, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. We believe that diverse perspectives enrich our workplace and drive our success.

jobs.title: Business Development Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~16,800 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do. Our award\-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry\-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers. Responsibilities: Keysight Technologies is seeking a driven, technically minded early\-career Business Development Engineer to open doors and build pipeline across the Dallas and Austin corridors. This is a launch role for a recent Electrical (or similar) engineering graduate who wants a career in technical sales. You will own outbound prospecting into new and underpenetrated accounts, with a primary focus on the region's fast\-growing AI and data center infrastructure companies, alongside semiconductor and emerging technology accounts. This is a field\-oriented role. You will spend 1\-2 days per week on customer sites, including cold walk\-ins, and you will work closely with account managers, industry solution teams, and application engineers who will coach you as you convert first conversations into qualified opportunities. The successful candidate is curious, resourceful, and energized by getting in front of engineers at accounts where Keysight has little or no existing presence. Accountabilities: * Build pipeline in the region's AI and data center infrastructure segment as the primary focus, prospecting into the companies deploying and validating AI compute clusters, high\-speed networking and optics, and the power systems behind them. * Meet and exceed funnel growth expectations by generating qualified pipeline in new and underpenetrated accounts across the Dallas and Austin metros. * Execute high\-volume, multi\-channel outbound prospecting across phone, email, LinkedIn, industry events, and in\-person visits. * Spend 1\-2 days per week in the field visiting customer sites, including conducting cold walk\-ins, often alongside local account managers, to engage engineering and program stakeholders face to face. * Research and map target accounts, identifying the design, test, and validation engineers behind each program and tailoring outreach to their technical challenges. * Qualify leads into sales\-qualified opportunities and drive clean handoffs to account managers, staying engaged through early opportunity development. * Maintain rigorous Salesforce discipline, ensuring accurate activity logging, account intelligence, and funnel visibility. * Present territory plans, account insights, and results to sales management with clarity and confidence. * Partner with field marketing, industry solution teams, and application engineers to coordinate demos, evaluations, and event follow\-up. * Complete Keysight's technical onboarding curriculum in RF, digital, and test fundamentals, and build working knowledge of Keysight's design, emulation, and test portfolio to hold credible first conversations with engineers. * Represent Keysight at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry meetups to source new contacts and opportunities. Qualifications: * BS in Engineering required (Electrical/Computer Engineering preferred), completed or graduating within the academic year. * 0\-2 years of professional experience; internships, co\-ops, campus jobs, or student organization leadership in sales, engineering, or customer\-facing roles all count. * Genuine interest in building a career in technical sales and in the AI and data center infrastructure market. * Familiarity with high\-speed digital concepts such as PCIe, Ethernet, DDR, and SerDes from coursework or lab work, or a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on them, strongly preferred. * Comfortable getting in front of people and willing to conduct cold walk\-ins on customer sites. * Must reside in, or be willing to relocate to, the Dallas or Austin metro area, with the ability to visit customers in person 1\-2 days per week. * Self\-starter who can build a plan, prioritize accounts, and sustain prospecting activity, while taking coaching and feedback well. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with engineers, technical managers, and executives. * Comfortable presenting in front of management and customers. * Track record of achievement in academics, athletics, work, or campus leadership. * Working understanding of RF/microwave, digital, or general\-purpose electronics from coursework or lab experience, and strong aptitude to learn test and measurement applications. * Willingness to learn Salesforce and modern prospecting tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, ZoomInfo, and Clay. * Valid driver's license and willingness to travel locally throughout the Dallas/Fort Worth and Austin metros, including occasional travel between them. Pay Range: USD $76,100\.00 \- USD $126,830\.00 Year Careers Privacy Statement\*\*\*Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.\*\*\*

producers and downstream consumers. * Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for complex production incidents and implement measures to prevent recurrence. * Participate in production support and on\-call responsibilities for business\-critical data products. * Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge\-sharing sessions. * Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements aligned with Kiewit's long\-term data platform strategy. * Use AI\-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering productivity, testing, documentation, and solution quality. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 10\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Advanced experience with Python and SQL in production environments. * Proven experience designing and supporting scalable batch and/or streaming data pipelines. * alerting, and operational controls for production data systems. * Familiarity with source control, code reviews, CI/CD, and deployment automation. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, analytics, security, governance, and business teams. * Strong problem\-solving, prioritization, ownership, and decision\-making skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Apache Spark and lakehouse technologies such as Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg. * jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **COMPANY SUMMARY** Since 1992, Kingland has been a leading provider of enterprise software products, using innovative problem solving to address many of the most complex data, risk, and regulatory compliance challenges for some of the most integral companies in the world. Because our actions and decisions are guided by our purpose – delivering confidence to make the world work better – we create predictability, consistency, and trust in our business. This allows Kingland to serve like no one else can, upholding our values of authenticity, creativity, excellence, and ownership, enabling our clients to use data to confidently manage risk and comply with regulations. We believe that every employee plays an important role in the business and contributes to the success and growth that we continue to experience. We seek individuals with unique skill sets that have the desire to work on mission\-critical programs. We believe in the value of in\-person connection and interactions within our US offices in Ames and Clear Lake, Iowa and Fort Myers, Florida, while also offering team members flexibility that supports the unique needs of both their work and personal lives. By using best practices in developing and maintaining enterprise\-class software products, you can be a part of an amazing team committed to our purpose and values. We hope that you will choose to launch yourself into an exciting new adventure at Kingland. **POSITION SUMMARY** \| Senior Software Engineer As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll have the opportunity to apply familiar technologies such as Go, JavaScript, Vue, Postgres, and AWS to solve novel problems. You’ll be responsible for working with other engineers as a leader to establish coding principles and design patterns that stand the test of time. You’ll also work with product and engagement teams to understand the problem your team is solving and constantly test and validate your team’s work against the problem statement. Your engineering team’s output will then be used in downstream products to ensure our customers’ success! If you're curious about how technology should work and enjoy solving problems, this is the right space for you. Use your creativity, share your point of view with clients and colleagues, and have enough grit to see the project to its end. It's like a puzzle. You know there are multiple ways to solve it. Every tool will be at your disposal, and you'll be able to test your ideas with experienced professionals in the organization. **RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES** \| Senior Software Engineer * Serve as a primary engineering expertise on the project, providing guidance on engineering principles and mentoring other engineers on the team * Work with Architects to create designs that follow industry standard software design patterns and best practices * Develop highly secure, performant and maintainable code based on software designs for Kingland Platform solutions * Actively participate in an Agile development process, collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams, delivering working software in short iterations, and adapting to changing requirements through frequent feedback loops, all while utilizing Agile methodologies like Scrum and Kanban to ensure efficient project delivery * Continually improve engineering principles to ensure the engineering team delivers with quality and velocity * Leverage automated build and deploy processes to create and execute integration tests * Identify, fix and communicate defects throughout the software engineering process * Collaborate with teammates and clients, from requirements review and design to implementation, testing, deployment and triage * Assist with onboarding new engineers and maintaining engineering routines within the team **POSITION REQUIREMENTS** \| Senior Software Engineer * Bachelor’s degree and requisite experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering or Computer Engineering is required * A minimum of 5 years of professional software development experience, preferably in Cloud\-based infrastructures * Enterprise software development using Go, Java, C\# or other backend programming languages * Frontend Web Application development using Vue, Angular, React or other JavaScript frameworks * Database development and maintenance using SQL on Postgres or other similar relational databases * Knowledge of key engineering principles such as clean code, api\-first development, and devsecops * Strong organization and leadership skills **BENEFITS** Kingland has a suite of world class benefits and perks. Because we understand that each team member is unique, we offer generous and flexible health and welfare, wellness, lifestyle, and total rewards benefits that are carefully picked and well designed. We are authentic in our commitment to providing team members with an exceptional experience and work hard to ensure that each individual feels valued and supported in their role and can advance their career through development plans and growth opportunities. Visit Kingland.com/Careers (https://www.kingland.com/kingland\-careers) for additional details! **LOCATION** * Kingland offers modern office locations in our Ames, Iowa; Clear Lake, Iowa; or Fort Myers, Florida Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

Our main goal is to ensure that Klaviyos everywhere have a strong technology foundation to do great work. The IT Team solves problems using technology and provides Klaviyo's continued scalability and sustainable employee growth in a rapidly evolving environment. You'll contribute to projects that range from SSO/SCIM implementations to multi\-tool integrations and automations, with a focus on scalability and efficiency. You'll work closely with operations, engineering, and the IT Searchbar team to keep systems healthy and help work through technical escalations. Klaviyo is building an AI\-first future, and IT is where a lot of that gets real. You will be expected to use AI in your day\-to\-day work to research, script, document, and troubleshoot faster, and to help bring AI\-assisted workflows to the systems we run for the rest of the company. This is a hands\-on, high\-learning role for someone early in their systems career who wants to build depth quickly alongside senior engineers. ### **How you'll have an impact** * Own your projects and tickets end to end from problem statement to rollout to documentation and when you see something broken, fix it or get it to the right owner rather than route around it. * Ship changes quickly to systems that thousands of Klaviyos rely on, while testing your work, getting a peer review, and having a rollback plan before you touch production. Exposure to Windows management such as Intune and Autopilot is a plus. * Interest in learning how to automate workflows and repetitive tasks. * Some experience with or willingness to learn IdP configuration, management, and maintenance, including SSO (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM provisioning. Experience with Okta or Entra ate access matters. * Comfort reading API documentation and working with REST and JSON to connect systems together, or a clear appetite to learn. * A disciplined approach to change: you test before you deploy, document what you changed, and communicate clearly with the people it affects. * Strong written communication and a habit of documenting your work. * Participation in an after\-hours on\-call rotation with the IT Systems team is required for site\-specific or business\-blocking issues. ### **Nice to have** * Familiarity with SSO and automation solutions such as Workato, Okta Workflows, n8n, or similar. * Basic understanding of enterprise\-scale networking topics including routing, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and corporate Wi\-Fi. * Experience in a fast\-paced, high\-growth IT environment is preferred. * Interest in developing skills to build applications and tools that utilize APIs. * Familiarity with AWS and GCP concepts such as VPC, EC2, Security Groups, ACLs, and IAM is a plus. * Experience building with AI beyond the chat window prompt and context engineering, connecting an LLM to systems via APIs or MCP, or standing up an AI\-assisted workflow or agent that saved real time. * Experience administering an ITSM or ticketing platform such as Freshservice or Jira Service Management, including forms, workflows, and reporting. * Relevant certifications such as Jamf 100/200, Okta Certified Professional, CompTIA A\+, Network\+, or Security\+, or AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud fundamentals. *This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.* **Get to Know Klaviyo** We're Klaviyo (pronounced clay\-vee\-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first\-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we're developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, where you'll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you'll join us. *AI fluency at Klaviyo includes responsible use of AI (including privacy, security, bias awareness, and human\-in\-the\-loop). We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non\-company email addresses (@klaviyo.com), instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.* **By clicking "Submit Application" you consent to Klaviyo processing your Personal Data in accordance with our Job Applicant Privacy Notice. jobs.title: AI Engineer II / III
jobs.description: ### **Description** Kriya is a biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to develop life\-changing gene therapies for diseases affecting millions of patients around the world. We leverage our proprietary computational engine, in\-house manufacturing infrastructure, and integrated design platform to engineer technologies and therapeutics with the potential to transform the treatment of a broad universe of diseases of high unmet need, with a focus on metabolic disorders, neurology, and ophthalmology. We are proud to have been named **Triangle Business Journal’s Life Sciences 2024 “Best Private Company to Work For,”** recognized by Forbes as one of **“America’s Best Startup Employers of 2024,” and honored as one of BioSpace’s “2025 Best Places to Work.”** ### **Role Overview** The AI Engineer designs, builds, and operates agentic AI systems, retrieval infrastructure, and data pipelines that help realize Kriya's AI strategy. This role’s responsibilities include developing custom AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and MCP connectors that make Kriya's data accessible to AI tools. As a member of Kriya's Applied Computation \& AI (ACAI) team, the AI Engineer partners closely with stakeholders across the organization to ship production\-grade AI systems quickly while meeting Kriya's security, compliance, and governance standards. This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, hands\-on experience with modern agentic AI and cloud/data infrastructure, and the judgment to translate ambiguous scientific and business needs into reliable systems. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems and LLM\-based tools, including specialized, on\-demand AI agent\-contractors (e.g., scientific review, competitive intelligence, experimental design, manufacturing analysis) and custom AI skills and plugins, using orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, AWS Bedrock / AgentCore, or similar. * Build, evaluate, and maintain retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and vector search capabilities over Kriya's internal data, exposing that data to AI tools via MCP connectors and unified APIs. * Develop production\-grade data pipelines connecting Kriya's datalake to AI applications, ensuring architecture, access patterns, and governance meet downstream AI requirements. * Apply strong software engineering practices — testing, CI/CD, version control, observability, and monitoring — to build reliable, secure, and maintainable AI systems. * Collaborate cross\-functionally across functions such as CMC, Clinical, Corporate Strategy, Legal, and Finance to implement high\-value opportunities for agentic AI and computational solutions, translating scientific and business needs into technical designs. * Provide technical leadership on agent architecture and AI system design, model best practices for the team, and mentor junior team members. ### **Experience \& Skills and Work Environment** **Experience \& Skills*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * Advanced degree preferred. * 3\-7\+ years of experience as a software, ML, or AI engineer (level based on depth of experience with agentic systems and scope of technical leadership). An equivalent combination of education and experience is acceptable. * Hands\-on experience building agentic AI systems / multi\-step LLM workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, AWS Bedrock / AgentCore, CrewAI, or similar. * Experience building RAG systems, including chunking, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval evaluation. * Strong Python engineering skills, including API development and integration (MCP, REST). * Experience with AWS cloud services (e.g., Lambda, S3, Bedrock, IAM) and Databricks or similar platforms, with solid data engineering fundamentals (ETL pipelines, data modeling, structured and unstructured data). * Experience with LLMs and prompt engineering / evaluation practices. * Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative development practices (CI/CD, code review, testing). * Life sciences, biotech, or pharma experience preferred, including familiarity with GxP\-adjacent data governance and lab or manufacturing information systems (e.g., ELN/LIMS). * Scientific curiosity and analytical mindset, with the ability to translate ambiguous stakeholder needs into technical solutions. * Excellent written and verbal communication for working with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Self\-directed with ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environment. **Work Environment*** Primarily desk\-based, generally in an office or home office setting. * May involve extended periods of sitting and computer use. ### **Life at Kriya** **Discover True Collaborative Teamwork** We have an ambitious set of goals, but our confidence – and our inspiration – stems from our people. From California to North Carolina, our teammates bring a spirit of Collaboration, Leadership, and Innovation to their work every day. We’re always looking for teammates with the drive and energy to help us grow. If you want to be a part of a company with an entrepreneurial culture, a bold vision, and a meaningful purpose, join us. **Rewards \& Benefits** * Time Off \& Work\-Life Balance: Flexible Time Off Paid Parental \& Medical Leave Paid Company Holidays * Health \& Wellness:Fertility \& Family Building Benefits Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Life Insurance Short\- and Long\-Term Disability Coverage * Financial Security:Equity 401(k) with Company Match Identity Theft Protection * And More! ### **About Kriya Therapeutics** won't let me leave this section blank *Kriya is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Product Manager – Agentic Modernization
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. **The Role** Kyndryl is looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle of Kyndryl's platform for Agentic Modernization — the platform that enables enterprises to modernize applications, processes, and operations through AI agents and agentic workflows. This role bridges customer needs, business objectives, and AI technology capabilities to deliver a secure, scalable, and enterprise\-grade platform for building, deploying, governing, and operating AI agents at scale. This is a senior, cross\-functional leadership role.
