jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Serval is an AI\-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real\-world workflows and execute them end\-to\-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high\-volume, high\-friction operational work across their organizations. At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production\-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering. Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving. We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others. **Role Overview** ================= With Serval, an automation that used to take a SOW and a quarter now takes a sentence and an afternoon. That one change is why Automation Engineering is becoming the operating model for enterprise services, and why service teams stop being a bottleneck and start being an advantage. As an Automation Engineer, you build Serval's agents directly into the customer's instance, and the tickets stop arriving: onboarding, access requests, approvals, the long tail that clogs a service desk. You'll push Serval past its current limits into new use cases, dogfood unreleased features, bring field ideas back to our product team, and act as a practitioner evangelist for both Serval and Automation Engineering. This is a title we are coining. Nobody has ten years of it yet, so what you build becomes the standard for everyone after you. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Build in the platform:** design and build automations and AI agents inside customers' Serval instances, from onboarding and access requests to the long tail that clogs a service desk. * **Wire up the stack:** integrate Serval with customer systems (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, ServiceNow, Workday) so automations complete end to end. * **Run working sessions:** embed with IT, HR, Finance, and Legal teams, pull the real process out of them, and turn it into something buildable the same day. * **Enable customer builders:** turn what you build into reusable patterns and teach customers' own teams to extend them, so adoption compounds after you leave. * **Partner with Deployment:** work alongside Deployment Strategists to hit the milestones a customer signed up for, and surface risk early when a use case is going sideways. **What You’ll Need** ==================== * Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 2\+ years in a relevant role (IT or service operations, professional services, solutions engineering, business systems, technical support). * Working knowledge of APIs and REST, JSON, and IAM concepts including SSO, SCIM, and provisioning. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to run a working session, challenge a requirement, and translate technical tradeoffs for non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to learn unfamiliar software quickly and work independently across several customer accounts. **Nice to Have** ================ * Experience in an early\-stage startup environment. * Hands\-on time administering or migrating an ITSM platform (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Freshservice, Zendesk). * Familiarity with IT, security, service management, or workflow automation. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Impact**: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company. * **Growth**: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company. * **Culture**: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun. Compensation Range: $105K \- $220K

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. This role owns what happens after training: building the resilient, low\-latency ML backend systems that turn static model artifacts into high\-throughput, cloud\-scale safety features. You will partner closely with applied scientists, firmware and full\-stack engineers, and product managers and you will build the ML APIs, data pipelines, and evaluation infrastructure that let Safety AI models run efficiently at fleet scale, closing the loop from initial integration through rollout monitoring and iteration to a trustworthy, customer\-facing signal. applications. * Establish practical standards for productionizing models — how they're served, evaluated, versioned, and monitored once they leave applied science. * Set a high bar for reliability: rigorous evaluation, measurable rollout health, and systems that degrade predictably rather than silently. * Act as a technical partner to applied scientists, helping translate research outputs into systems that are debuggable, scalable, and cost\-efficient in production. #### **In this role, you will:** * **Design Production ML APIs:** Architect and maintain reliable, low\-latency APIs to integrate Safety AI model outputs directly into cloud applications. * **Build Data Flywheels:** Construct scalable pipelines to power continuous model iteration, backtesting, shadow and online evaluation, enabling fast and safe deployments. * **Optimize \& Serve Artifacts:** Productionize model artifacts handed off by applied scientists, optimizing serving logic and fine\-tuning models for platform\-specific workloads. * **Petabyte\-Scale Operations:** Process high\-volume camera and sensor telematics data to support model execution, backtesting, and automated dataset curation. * **Monitor \& Maintain Rollout Health:** Build systems to track model drift, precision/recall, and latency regressions in production, ensuring predictable failure modes and closed\-loop data feedback. * **Cross\-Functional System Integration:** Partner with firmware and platform teams to optimize edge\-to\-cloud model execution, balancing latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost. * **Product Collaboration:** Work with product managers to translate safety requirements into scalable technical architectures. * Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. **Minimum requirements for the role:** * 6\+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, with a track record of shipping models in production. * Strong proficiency in one or more common languages (e.g., C\+\+, Golang, Java, Python, Scala). * Proficiency with common ML tools (e.g. Ray/Ray Serve, MLflow, Grafana, Pytorch, Spark, etc). * Experience deploying and iteratively refining models using real customer feedback loops. * Comfort with full\-stack/backend development — you understand the data structures and dependencies underneath your models. * BS or MS in Computer Science or a related quantitative field. **An ideal candidate also has:** * Ph.D. in Computer Science or a quantitative discipline (e.g., Applied Math, Physics, Statistics). * Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure\-as\-code frameworks. * Experience deploying and managing ML applications in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), including cloud\-based storage, processing, and inference. * Experience shipping end\-to\-end ML applications from artifact to production, ideally in safety\-critical or high\-scale domains. * Expertise optimizing distributed model training with GPUs. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** GibbsCAM is one of the most established CAM platforms in the manufacturing industry, with a history spanning more than 40 years. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team of engineers who take genuine pride in craft, reliability, and building software that real machinists depend on every day. This is a strong growth opportunity for an engineer with a solid foundation in C\+\+ and a curiosity about complex, domain\-rich software. You will work alongside experienced senior engineers who are invested in mentorship and knowledge transfer, and you will have the opportunity to take on meaningful, challenging work from day one. The role suits someone who is eager to learn a specialized domain, comfortable reading and reasoning about code they did not write, and excited to grow their skills within a stable, long\-lived product. This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates authorized to work and residing in the United States. **Primary Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain software features for a large\-scale Windows desktop CAM application, working from specifications provided by Product Management and senior engineers. * Diagnose and resolve defects in existing code, with guidance from senior team members on complex issues spanning large or unfamiliar subsystems. * Perform repair, enhancement, and maintenance of software components, writing clean and well\-tested code that meets the team’s quality standards. * Participate actively in code reviews — both as an author and a reviewer — contributing to a culture of shared ownership and continuous improvement. * Learn and apply relevant domain concepts in CAM and manufacturing as needed to contribute effectively to the product. * Maintain currency with modern C\+\+ and software development best practices, applying them appropriately within the constraints of a mature codebase. * Contribute to technical documentation and assist in keeping internal knowledge bases current. * Consult with senior engineers and management on project status, technical questions, and implementation approaches. **Required Qualifications** * 3–5 years of professional software development experience in a production environment. * Solid proficiency in C and C\+\+; exposure to modern standards (C\+\+11/14/17\) preferred. * Experience reading, debugging, and extending existing codebases — not just writing code from scratch. * Familiarity with Windows desktop application development. * Working knowledge of debugging tools and the ability to systematically isolate and resolve software defects. * Understanding of core data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design principles. * Experience with version control in a team setting. * Solid math fundamentals and willingness to engage with technical or geometric concepts as needed by the domain. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Win32, MFC, COM, or other Windows application frameworks. * Exposure to C\# in a mixed\-language (C\+\+/managed) application context. * Any experience or academic background in CAD, CAM, CNC machining, or manufacturing. * Familiarity with 3D graphics concepts or APIs (OpenGL, DirectX, or similar). * Background or coursework in applied mathematics, linear algebra, or computational geometry. * Experience with Perforce or other enterprise version control systems. * Exposure to large\-project build systems. **Education** * Bachelor’s degree required , with preferred focus in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering. * Equivalent practical experience demonstrating the required technical foundation will be considered. **What to Expect** We understand that a specialized product like GibbsCAM takes time to learn. New team members work with our experienced engineers who provide direction and mentorship during onboarding, and we set realistic expectations for ramp\-up time. We are more interested in hiring someone with strong fundamentals and genuine curiosity than someone who already checks every domain\-specific box. Our team values steady, high\-quality work over heroics. You’ll have the opportunity to grow into greater ownership and technical leadership over time as you build familiarity with the product and codebase. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.description: Responsibilities: This position will offer you the ability to directly apply your knowledge of protective relaying and controls systems for HV and EHV substations. Schematic diagrams. * Prepare engineering studies for client and peer review. * Perform independent reviews of work performed by others including calculations and drawing preparation. * Coordinate and provide guidance to other engineers, project managers, client personnel, and suppliers to ensure a complete and timely design. * Perform reviews of existing facilities to propose upgrades and replacements, and present findings and recommendations to clients and peers. * Develop your career via peer\-learning through sharing of knowledge with other experienced engineers by way of Sargent \& Lundy’s systems of process and associated “Communities of Practice.” * Provide guidance as a mentor in the development of less experienced engineers. * There is the potential for you to travel to client and vendor offices for design reviews and to plant site locations for construction coordination and field verification of designs. jobs.title: Electrical & Embedded Systems Co-op
jobs.description: Job Description: Schneider Electric's Secure Power and Data Center Division is driving the next generation of power and infrastructure solutions for AI, cloud computing, and hyperscale data centers. As AI workloads continue to grow, intelligent power distribution, digital power conversion, and real\-time infrastructure monitoring have become critical technologies enabling reliable and efficient operation of modern data centers. As an Electrical \& Embedded Systems Co\-op, you will join a multidisciplinary R\&D team developing intelligent Rack Power Distribution Units (rPDUs), high\-density power shelves, and advanced embedded control systems for AI infrastructure. This role provides hands\-on experience working at the intersection of power electronics, embedded systems and edge AI development. Duration: January 2027\-July 2027 **What will you do?** As a member of our cross functional R\&D team, you will:* Collaborate with electrical, firmware, mechanical, and test engineers to develop intelligent rack PDUs and high\-density power shelves for AI data centers. * Support embedded hardware bring\-up, board debugging, and system integration activities. * Develop and validate embedded software, device drivers, and communication interfaces using C and Python. * Assist in implementing digital control algorithms for advanced power converters and power management systems. * Explore embedded AI applications for predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and intelligent power monitoring. * Work with communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, and Ethernet. * Perform laboratory testing, system validation, and performance characterization of hardware and firmware. * Support schematic review, PCB development, technical documentation, and product lifecycle management activities using Cadence and PDM tools. (External) English Qualifications: **What qualifications will make you successful for this role?** **Required qualifications*** Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems or a related technical field. * Strong understanding of embedded systems fundamentals. * Proficiency in C programming. * Experience with Python for scripting, automation, or data analysis. * Familiarity with microcontrollers, embedded processors, and real\-time systems. * Knowledge of common communication protocols including UART, SPI, and I²C. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Located and able to work in Andover, MA. * ***All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. The company does not provide sponsorship now or in the future.*** **Preferred qualifications*** Understanding of power electronics, switched\-mode power supplies and digital power control concepts. * Experience with STM32, TI C2000 embedded MCU platforms. * Exposure to machine learning, edge AI, TinyML, data analytics, or predictive maintenance applications. * Experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, and automated software testing. * Familiarity with schematic capture and PCB development tools such as Cadence. * Experience with AI model deployment on embedded devices is a plus. \#secareers Local Benefits (English): At Schneider Electric, we believe that every employee is a talent who deserves equal opportunities. jobs.description: **Company Overview** Scope Labs provides a full\-service startup ecosystem focused on design and development of digital platforms and experiences. You'll be embedded directly with our startup customers, owning the entire technical relationship from day one. We're looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering, product instinct, and customer partnership; someone who can walk into a startup's codebase on Monday and ship something meaningful by Friday. This role is for a builder who is equally comfortable digging into a customer's production environment and white boarding a new AI workflow with their engineering lead. You'll be deploying cutting\-edge AI tooling into real startup workflows at the frontier of what's possible, and you'll be the reason those deployments succeed. The specifics of what we're building are still under wraps, but if you're excited by the idea of being one of the first people to bring genuinely new technology into the hands of fast\-moving teams, this is that role. You will represent Scope Labs in the field. That means operating with autonomy, exercising strong judgment under ambiguity, and holding yourself accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. **Responsibilities** You'll own the full technical customer lifecycle. From initial deployment through activation and ongoing utilization, you are the person who makes sure our customers are actually getting value, not just access. You'll identify and champion high\-impact use cases. You'll work closely with startup engineering teams to understand their workflows, identify where AI can meaningfully accelerate them, and get those integrations shipped. You'll be the voice of the customer internally. You'll bring patterns, friction points, and product insights back to our Product and Engineering teams, helping shape the roadmap based on what you're seeing in the field. **Preferred Qualifications** * 3\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Software Engineer with consulting or startup experience. Former technical founders are strongly encouraged to apply. * Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript with a track record of shipping production software. * Hands\-on experience deploying or integrating AI tooling, including LLMs, AI agents, or AI\-native developer tools, into real workflows. * High agency with comfort operating in ambiguous environments and limited direction. * Strong communication skills across audiences, from senior engineers to non\-technical founders. * Team\-first attitude with the ability to juggle multiple customer engagements simultaneously. **Bonus Points** * Experience with AI agent frameworks, MCP servers, or autonomous coding tools in production. * Background in a specific startup or enterprise vertical such as fintech, developer tools, or healthcare. * Direct UX/UI experience or strong product sense. * A portfolio of passion projects or initiatives you've directly built or majority\-contributed to. *If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!* **Salary and Benefits** The expected salary range for this role is based on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Front End (Customer Experience)
jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! #### **Overview** As a Senior Frontend Engineer on the Customer Experience team, you will be a core contributor to the customer\-facing experiences that define how people buy a vehicle with us. You will build and maintain high\-quality frontend features across the purchase journey, working across trade\-in, vehicle configuration, finance and leasing, and delivery. You will work closely with product, design, and backend engineers to ship experiences that customers trust with high\-stakes decisions. You will take real ownership of features from design through delivery, contribute meaningfully to technical decisions within the team, and help raise the bar on frontend craft across the codebase. This role is ideal for an engineer who writes thoughtful, production\-quality frontend code, cares deeply about the customer experience, and wants to grow their skills in a complex, design\-rich, transactional product. #### **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: * Build and maintain polished, performant customer\-facing frontend features, writing clean, well\-tested code that your teammates can rely on and extend. * Implement UI components and application logic that are correct, accessible, and consistent with our design system, translating design intent into high\-fidelity, maintainable code. * Take end\-to\-end ownership of features from scoping and technical design through implementation, testing, and monitoring in production. * Integrate frontend experiences with backend APIs and third\-party services, handling loading states, error conditions, and edge cases thoughtfully. * Contribute to frontend performance work: improving Core Web Vitals, reducing bundle size, and ensuring the UI holds up under real\-world network and device conditions. * Participate actively in code and design reviews, sharing knowledge and helping maintain a high quality bar across the team. * Contribute to the shared component library and design system, helping keep it consistent, accessible, and easy for others to use. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to understand requirements and ship solutions that genuinely serve customers. * Treat accessibility as a core part of the job, building inclusive experiences by default rather than as a retrofit. * Use AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully to increase velocity and share effective practices with the team. **Location \& Travel Expectations**: * This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in **Fremont, California.** * This role requires 1 day per week in the office, with regular in\-person meetings and events. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. * Driver's License required for domestic travel. #### **What you'll bring** We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: * Education/Certifications: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field * 5\+ years of frontend engineering experience, with a track record of shipping production features end\-to\-end. * Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript, with a solid understanding of component patterns, state management, and application architecture. * Familiarity with modern frontend technologies including WebGL, GSAP, Framer Motion, and Astro is a strong plus. * Good eye for design and attention to detail, able to implement UIs that match design intent accurately and consistently. * Working knowledge of frontend performance fundamentals: Core Web Vitals, rendering strategies, and bundle optimization. * Practical understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG) and experience building accessible components. * Experience integrating frontend applications with REST or GraphQL APIs, including handling errors, loading states, and edge cases. * Collaborative and communicative, comfortable asking questions, flagging blockers, and contributing to team discussions. #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: * Competitive insurance including: + Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans * 401(k) program with: + An employer match and immediate vesting * Generous Paid Time Off including: + 20 days planned PTO, as accrued + 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually + Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders + Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave #### **Pay Transparency** This is a full\-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial base salary range \= $140,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 Initial California base salary range\= $154,000 \- $187,000 Internal leveling code: IC9 **Notice to applicants:** * To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. * Residing in **San Francisco**: *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* * Residing in **Los Angeles**: *Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.* * Residing in **New York City**: *This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.* **Equal Opportunity** Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre\-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, AI Agents & Automation
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability \& Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it — designing the signals that tell us when something's wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale. We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. Come join us. **What You'll Do** * Participate in an on\-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load). * Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). * Operate and improve our Kubernetes\-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure. * Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems. * runbooks and documentation so on\-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person. * Help define non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance — for new systems as they're designed. * Collaborate across engineering teams to adopt best practices in reliability and observability. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly. **What You'll Bring** * Kubernetes (must\-have): strong, hands\-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system. * AI\-native SRE practice (must\-have): hands\-on, personal experience using AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Workspace, Cursor, or custom agents built on Claude/MCP servers) to diagnose, automate, and resolve infrastructure and reliability work. + human in the loop) — not just general AI coding assistance. The coding assessment will be tailored to whichever language/framework you're most comfortable in. * Experience with distributed systems and their common failure modes (retries, timeouts, cascading failures). * Strong production troubleshooting skills — comfortable diagnosing issues under pressure. * 8\-10\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience. * Nice\-to\-have: database experience (not mandatory — databases are monitored by the same team, not owned individually). **About You** You're someone who enjoys being directly accountable for the reliability of a business\-critical, large\-scale enterprise system. jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Engineer
jobs.description: Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? **Transform the everyday with us!** Are you an Engineer with a passion for innovation and a proven track record of excellence? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you can shape processes from the ground up? If so, we invite you to join our team as a Continuous Improvement Engineer for our Operations Engineering team! This is a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of establishing world\-class engineering standards in a team that supports manufacturing in multiple locations across multiple countries. You will play a pivotal role in analyzing engineering workflows, elevate the engineering quality standards, and improving throughput. You will provide critical support to improve the quality of output from the engineering team, which is a crucial driver to scale up operations for the business unit. You will be directly responsible for modifying, establishing, and managing the quality control measures of our engineered\-to\-order (ETO) process, ensuring that custom drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), and all design documents are flawless before they hit the production floor. This hybrid Continuous Improvement Engineer role is based in Wendell, NC at Siemens EA U.S. headquarters. Located in the heart of the Research Triangle about 20 minutes east of Raleigh, Wendell offers top\-rated schools, a mild climate, easy access to mountains and coast, and a cost of living that allows our compensation to go further. **Local candidates are encouraged to apply**. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates. **You’ll make a difference by:** -------------------------------- * **Standardize ETO Quality Control:** Own, modify, and closely implement the quality control measures for all engineered\-to\-order (ETO) deliverables, including 3D CAD models, electrical schematics, and wiring diagrams. * **Proactive Defect Prevention:** Implement Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) during the custom drafting phase to catch and mitigate engineering quality risks before production release. * **Drive Root Cause Investigations:** Lead structured Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using 8D, A3s, and 5\-Why methodologies to trace shop\-floor assembly or wiring defects back to the root design documents. * **Close the Feedback Loop:** Establish and handle a robust engineering change notice (ECN) process that feeds manufacturing floor realities directly into master CAD models, engineering templates, and design standards. * **Error\-Proofing:** Work with design software administrators to implement digital error\-proofing mechanisms within CAD, ERP/PLM tools, Artificial intelligence tools to automate rule\-checking. * **Quality Standards Implementation:** Develop and implement rigorous quality standards for all phases of the ETO process. * **Quality KPI Improvement:** Lead efforts to continuously improve key Quality Performance Indicators (KPIs). * **Audit Management:** Represent and support audit processes based on ISO standards. * **Communication \& Representation:** Effectively communicate quality requirements, improvement ideas, and performance data to diverse audiences, including engineering teams, senior management, and executive leadership. * **Data Analysis \& Reporting:** Use sophisticated data analysis techniques to impact quality performance, identify trends, and predict potential issues. Develop and maintain dashboards using tools like Power BI, Tableau to provide clear, actionable insights and regular quality reports to management. **You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:** -------------------------------------------------------------- **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a closely related technical field. * Five (5\) or more years’ engineering experience in an electrical equipment manufacturing environment (e.g., switchgear, transformers, power distribution) with a heavy emphasis on design quality, configuration management, or ETO process control. * Expertise in implementing and optimizing quality processes using automation. * Thorough understanding of the challenges unique to custom, engineered\-to\-order (ETO) engineering operations and workflow automation. * Strong leadership skills with the ability to guide and mentor multidisciplinary teams without direct authority. * In\-depth knowledge and practical experience with Root Cause Analysis (8D, A3, Ishikawa) and CAPA processes. * Proficiency in process risk assessment methodologies (PFMEA, DFMEA) * Experience with tools and systems like SAP, Salesforce, and PowerBI. * Understanding and experience with ISO standards and auditing processes. * Willingness and ability to travel up to 20% based on business needs, including travel to other Siemens sites domestically and in Querétaro, Mexico. * Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification. * ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE). * Experience with electrical products. **About Siemens:** ------------------ We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource\-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here. **Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:** We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. $83,966 $143,942 5%

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer - Finance
jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. **Location: Hybrid (3 days) in Dublin, CA preferred; Menlo Park, CA also considered** **About the team** Enterprise Apps \& Agentic Systems is applying that standard internally. We partner directly with business teams to redesign high\-value domains from first principles and turn them into software\-defined, AI\-native products. We are customer zero for Snowflake technology: we build first\-of\-a\-kind solutions for our own teams, prove their value in production, and bring the learnings to our customers. We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead products that make our Finance, People, Legal, and other enterprise domains AI\-Native. This is not an application management role. You will own the product problem from discovery through value realization. You will identify where work should be eliminated, redesigned, automated, or delegated to software; define the product strategy; align the business and technology teams; and lead the delivery of products that people choose to use. ### **What you will do** * **Set product direction.** Develop a clear product vision, strategy, roadmap, and narrative for a meaningful business problem. Define the outcomes that matter, the choices required to achieve them, and the principles that guide trade\-offs. * **Partner directly with the business.** Work side by side with business leaders, operators, and end users from problem framing through launch and adoption. Build shared ownership of the problem and the solution rather than taking orders or handing off requirements. * **Build world\-class products.** Apply strong product judgment, user\-centered discovery, and first\-principles thinking to create simple, intuitive products that solve important problems and earn sustained adoption. * **Redesign workflows end to end.** Start with the desired business outcome, not the existing application or process. Decide what should disappear, what should be redesigned, and where software or agents can handle work end to end. * **Prototype rapidly.** Use AI tooling and modern product\-development techniques to turn ideas into working prototypes quickly. Put prototypes in front of users, learn from real behavior, and use evidence to decide what to build, change, or stop. * **Lead AI\-native product development.** Define and ship production\-grade agents and intelligent workflows that use trusted enterprise context and tools, operate within clear guardrails, manage exceptions, explain their actions, and bring people into the loop when judgment is required. * **Lead the product\-engineering partnership.** Work closely with engineering, design, data science, security, and platform teams on architecture and delivery trade\-offs, including context retrieval, orchestration, tool integration, evaluation, reliability, latency, privacy, and cost. * **Create alignment through storytelling.** Make complex problems and technical possibilities understandable. Communicate a compelling product narrative, facilitate hard decisions, align executives and delivery teams, and keep stakeholders current with clear, concise communication. * **Influence without authority.** Build coalitions across business and technology organizations, resolve competing priorities, influence platform roadmaps, and create momentum in an environment where ownership crosses organizational boundaries. * **Own adoption and outcomes.** Define success measures before launch and drive adoption after launch. Track usage, quality, trust, cycle time, automation, exception rates, decision latency, and business value realized. Use those signals to improve the product and make clear investment decisions. * **Operate responsibly.** Ensure products meet governance, auditability, SOX, data privacy, security, and responsible AI standards, especially when working with sensitive Finance, People, and Legal data. ### **What you bring** * A track record of building and scaling high\-quality software products that users value and that delivered meaningful business impact. Experience should demonstrate product ownership, not only program delivery, implementation, or application administration. * Strong product judgment: the ability to identify the highest\-value problem, challenge solution\-shaped requests, make trade\-offs, and focus teams on outcomes. * Experience partnering directly with business teams and users to discover problems, test assumptions, shape solutions, and drive adoption. You can earn trust with both senior executives and frontline practitioners. * Excellent communication and storytelling skills. You can simplify complexity, create a compelling point of view, write clearly, present with confidence, and align people around a direction. * Hands\-on experience using AI tools to rapidly prototype, test, and refine software solutions. You are comfortable learning new tools and turning an ambiguous idea into something users can react to. * Technical fluency in modern AI and software product development, including LLM and agent patterns, orchestration, tools, retrieval, evaluation, data, APIs, security, and production operations. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be able to lead an informed technical conversation and make sound product trade\-offs. * Experience taking products from discovery and zero\-to\-one development through launch, adoption, iteration, and scale. * The ability to thrive in ambiguity, create clarity, move quickly, and make hard decisions with incomplete information. * The ability to influence across functions and organizational boundaries without relying on formal authority. * Typically 8\+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience building and scaling software products. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is helpful but not required. ### **Bonus points** * Experience building products for internal enterprise teams or complex business domains. * Experience in Finance, People, Legal, Go\-to\-Market, or other operational functions. * Experience launching AI\-native or customer\-facing generative AI products. * Familiarity with Snowflake and the Data Cloud ecosystem. * Experience taking a product or capability from internal customer zero to a repeatable pattern that can help customers. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: * The estimated base salary range for this role is $236,000 \- $339,200\. * Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

jobs.title: Design Lead, Design Systems
jobs.description: **About Softline Solutions** Softline Solutions is a full\-service digital marketing agency based in Southern California that helps businesses grow online by increasing visibility, generating leads, and boosting sales. They build tailored, data\-driven campaigns across key digital channels and manage everything from strategy to execution and reporting. The goal is measurable growth, not buzzwords. **About the role** You'll own the design system and produce the work that proves what it's capable of. As our Design Lead, Design Systems, you're responsible for the design system infrastructure across Closet by Design, Closet World, and Brio Water, and for the executional design work that sets the quality benchmark every team can see, build from, and ship. This isn't a role where systems thinking exists in isolation from craft, or where craft stops at the Figma file. You'll think in systems, execute at a high level, and work closely with engineering to make sure quality follows the design all the way out the door.### **Own and Evolve the Design System** * Build, maintain, and evolve a unified but brand\-flexible design system, components, tokens, guidelines, and documentation, that serves all three UX product teams * Audit the current design state across brands, identify system gaps and inconsistencies, and create a roadmap to close them * Define component architecture, versioning, contribution workflows, and governance processes so the system scales as the team and products grow * Establish system architecture that supports speed without sacrificing consistency, so teams can move quickly without drifting from the standards ### **Execute High\-Quality Visual Design Work** * Produce polished, high\-fidelity visual work across all three brands, both production\-ready assets and forward\-looking concept work that shows the team where the bar is * Lead the visual design execution for Closet World, bringing the craft and vision to elevate the brand's digital experience and build the foundation the rest of the team can reference and grow from * Create the kind of work that sets the benchmark, not to keep it to yourself, but to show the team what excellent looks like and make it the new normal ### **Think Forward and Push the Quality Bar** * Develop future\-state design concepts and explorations that show what each brand experience can become, not just what it is today * Challenge assumptions in the current experience; bring fresh eyes, strong conviction, and the craft to back it up * Keep the team and leadership aligned on where design is headed, not just where it currently stands ### **Partner with Engineering to Ship Quality** * Work closely with engineering to ensure that what gets designed gets built right, own the design\-to\-dev handoff with care, precision, and a clear quality standard * Maintain spec fidelity through implementation; be the design voice in the build, not just the file, review shipped work and close quality gaps directly * Build and refine token pipelines and handoff documentation that make it easy for engineers to implement components correctly the first time * Foster a strong design\-engineering relationship, the kind where both sides understand each other's constraints and the shipped product reflects the intended design ### **Support and Elevate the UX Teams** * Partner closely with UX designers embedded across each brand to ensure system adoption is real and the work is strong, not just documented * Provide design direction, feedback, and executional support to elevate the output of the broader team * Make it easy for designers to use the system well, through clear documentation, reusable templates, and regular hands\-on collaboration ### **Move Fast Without Losing Quality** * Work in Figma and across the best available tooling to iterate at the speed the business requires * Balance fast\-turn requests from brand teams with long\-term system integrity, know when to move and when to hold the standard * Operate with ownership and autonomy, you don't wait to be told what needs improving **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Experience** * 8\+ years of design experience, with at least 3 years in a lead or senior IC role with direct design system ownership * A portfolio that demonstrates both strong design system work *and* strong visual design execution, you need to show us you can do both, not just one * Experience working across multiple brands or products simultaneously, with a track record of maintaining system coherence across varied contexts * E\-commerce, consumer products, or DTC background strongly preferred * Deep proficiency in Figma, variables, tokens, auto\-layout, component architecture, and prototyping, and fluency with the broader tooling ecosystem * Demonstrated track record of close engineering collaboration, you've done the full cycle: designed it, handed it off, reviewed the build, and driven it to the right quality ### **Skills** * Exceptional visual design craft, you have a strong point of view on what looks and feels right, and you can execute it at the highest level * Systems thinker who can architect a design system from principles to production and communicate it clearly to developers and non\-designers alike * Comfortable producing a wide range of output: component documentation, high\-fidelity UX flows, brand\-level concept work, and future\-state visions * Strong design\-to\-engineering collaboration, comfortable reviewing live implementations, giving precise feedback in build contexts, and working directly with developers to close the gap between design intent and shipped product * Craft\-driven brand thinking, the ability to use design not just to solve UX problems, but to push a brand forward: elevate how it looks, how it feels, and how it's experienced across every touchpoint * Able to give and receive direct design feedback with confidence and clarity * Self\-directed and organized, you can manage work across three active brands and multiple system tracks without losing threads ### **Mindset** * Driven by craft, you genuinely care about the quality of the output, very detailed oriented, not just the process; quality means what's shipped, not just what's in the file * Ownership\-oriented, you see a gap and close it; you see a problem and fix it; you don't wait for someone to tell you where to look * Energized by raising the bar, making the team better, making the work better, and building something that outlasts your individual contributions * Collaborative without losing your point of view, you'll give direct design feedback, push back when the work isn't there yet, and advocate strongly for what good looks like * Partnership\-minded with engineering, you understand that great design only matters when it ships right, and you take ownership of the handoff as seriously as the design itself * Comfortable working at speed without sacrificing quality, you know how to make smart trade\-offs and you move accordingly **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building a design system from near\-zero (greenfield) state * Familiarity with design token pipelines and design\-to\-dev handoff tooling *(Style Dictionary, Theo, etc.)* * Background in brand identity or brand systems work across multiple consumer brands * Experience working across retail \+ DTC simultaneously * Exposure to front\-end implementation concepts, enough to speak engineering's language fluently and catch implementation issues on sight **Why This Role** ----------------- * **You'll own something that matters.** The design system is the infrastructure that every brand experience runs on, getting it right has real, visible business impact across three growing consumer brands * **There's a significant opportunity to make your mark.** Closet World has the audience, the business momentum, and the investment to support a real step\-change in design quality, and this role is the engine that drives that forward * **Direct visibility to leadership.** What you build here goes to the Creative Director and brand leadership, not into a backlog * **You'll have the tools and the latitude.** We're investing in the right tooling and giving this person the autonomy to set direction, not just execute against someone else's spec * **Path to grow.** As design systems scale and the brand design bar rises, this role grows with it **The pay range for this role is:** 155,000 \- 180,000 USD per year(Headquarters)

Join PlayStation as a Software Engineer II focused on developing reliable, automated infrastructure platforms that support data services used by millions of players worldwide. You'll work across software development, Infrastructure as Code, database infrastructure, and operational reliability. You'll also help develop APIs and agent\-assisted experiences that make infrastructure creation and management simpler, safer, and more accessible to engineering teams. ### **Role Overview** We are seeking a Software Engineer II to help build, automate, and operate scalable data infrastructure across cloud environments. This role combines backend software development with infrastructure automation and operational engineering. You'll develop Go services, APIs, Terraform modules, and automation for provisioning and managing databases, streaming platforms, and caching services such as Cassandra, Aurora, Aerospike, Kafka, and Redis. You'll also contribute to enabling self\-service experiences that translate developer intent into validated infrastructure configurations and provisioning workflows. Working alongside senior engineers and platform teams, you'll help ensure these capabilities are reliable, secure, observable, and safe to operate at scale. ### **Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain software, APIs, and automation for provisioning and managing database, streaming, and caching infrastructure. * Build and maintain reusable Terraform modules and Infrastructure as Code workflows for cloud, Kubernetes, and data\-platform services. * Develop backend services and platform tooling in Go to support infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management. * Automate operational activities such as deployment, configuration, scaling, upgrades, backup, recovery, failover, and decommissioning. * Help operate and improve SQL, NoSQL, streaming, and caching platforms at scale, including technologies such as Cassandra, Aurora, Aerospike, Kafka/MSK, Redis, DynamoDB, and ElastiCache. * Contribute to the availability, scalability, performance, and reliability of stateful data services * Help build self\-service and agent\-assisted experiences that translate developer intent into structured infrastructure specifications and Terraform\-based execution plans. * Build and enhance observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts. * Participate in on\-call rotations and incident response for database, caching, streaming, and supporting platform services. * Troubleshoot infrastructure and application issues involving database performance, capacity, connectivity, replication, storage, and resource utilization. * Contribute to root\-cause analysis and implement automated or systemic fixes that prevent recurring incidents. * Help define and measure SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and operational health indicators for platform services. * Create automated tests for APIs, Terraform modules, infrastructure plans, operational tooling, and failure scenarios. * Collaborate with engineering, platform, security, and operations teams to deliver reliable and scalable data services. * Maintain technical documentation, API specifications, operational playbooks, runbooks, and onboarding materials. * Participate in code reviews, design discussions, capacity planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. ### **Skills and Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of experience in software engineering, database reliability engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or a related field. * Experience developing production software, backend services, or infrastructure tooling in Go. * Hands on experience using Terraform to provision and manage cloud infrastructure. * Experience developing APIs, including interface design, validation, error handling, testing, and versioning. * Working knowledge of one or more SQL, NoSQL, streaming, or caching technologies, such as Cassandra, Aurora, Aerospike, Kafka, AWS MSK, Redis, DynamoDB, or ElastiCache. * Understanding of database and distributed\-system concepts such as replication, partitioning, consistency, availability, fault tolerance, backup, and recovery. * Familiarity with the operational requirements of stateful systems, including capacity planning, performance monitoring, scaling, upgrades, backup and recovery, and incident troubleshooting. * Experience with AWS or GCP, including familiarity with cloud networking, identity, compute, storage, and managed data services. * Working knowledge of Kubernetes and experience deploying or operating containerized workloads. * Understanding of Linux, networking, storage systems, and common troubleshooting techniques. * Familiarity with observability practices, including metrics, structured logging, tracing, alerting, and dashboards. * Experience writing unit, integration, and automated end\-to\-end tests. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with an interest in infrastructure automation and distributed\-system reliability. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building internal developer platforms, self\-service infrastructure, or infrastructure APIs. * Experience using AI/ML or generative AI to improve infrastructure automation, operational workflows, incident management, observability, or developer productivity. * Familiarity with agent\-assisted workflows, structured outputs, tool\-calling integrations, approval controls, or policy\-based infrastructure automation. * Relevant AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, database, or streaming\-platform certifications. jobs.description: At **Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU)**, our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people\-first philosophy. **As a** **Cybersecurity Engineer,** you will be responsible for protecting the credit union’s digital assets, sensitive customer information, and internal systems from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and managing security measures to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data and systems. Responsibilities and expectations will scale according to the candidate's experience level **Why Join SCCU?** * **Member\-Focused Mission**: Be part of a not\-for\-profit organization that reinvests in its members. * **Flexible Schedule Options** * **Career Growth**: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on\-the\-job training. **Cybersecurity Engineer I Key Responsibilities** * Monitor security systems (SIEM/Endpoint Protection (AV, EDR, Zero Day, APT), DLP, IPS/IDS, NAC and rogue device detection) for suspicious activities and anomalies. * Respond to security incidents, conducting root cause analysis and coordinating remediation efforts. * Identify, analyze, and respond to security threats and vulnerabilities. * Perform threat hunting and advanced detection activities to protect systems and data. * Lead the planning, testing, and scheduling of system patches across all endpoints, mobile devices, servers, and network infrastructure. * Develop and maintain a patch management schedule and ensure timely application of security patches and updates. * Coordinate with various teams to minimize disruption and ensure compatibility of patches with organizational systems. * Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing. Identify and prioritize risks, working with IT teams to remediate vulnerabilities and implement patches. * Design, implement, and manage security solutions, including firewalls, encryption protocols, access control systems, and data protection technologies. * Ensure compliance with regulations such as NCUA, PCI\-DSS, and other applicable industry standards. Assist in audits, both internal and external, and provide reports and documentation as required. * Develop, document, and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the organization’s cybersecurity posture. * Work closely with network, systems, and application teams to ensure security is integrated into the infrastructure. Support secure system and application development practices. * Assist in delivering cybersecurity training programs to staff, promoting awareness of security policies, phishing attacks, and safe computing practices. * Lead complex incident response efforts, coordinating with internal teams and external partners. Serve as the primary point of contact during high\-impact security incidents. **Cybersecurity Engineer I Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field. jobs.title: Senior ML Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Are you a kid at heart looking to build a career with a leading global children's toy, entertainment and digital gaming company? At Spin Master, our unwavering commitment to open mindedness, integrity and innovation is a great part of what has made us an industry leader. How do we stay ahead of the pack? By hiring the best and brightest minds—and that’s why we want you! **Job Description:** -------------------- **Hapiko and the Stickerbox Story** Hapiko, a new part of the Spin Master family, is the creator of Stickerbox, an AI sticker printer for kids. A child holds a button, says "a unicorn riding a slice of pizza through space," and seconds later, a physical sticker prints out. This is powered by a proprietary generation pipeline that turns a child's idea into safe, fun, printed art in just a few seconds. **What will you work on?** You aren’t just one of a dozen ML engineers lost in a Big Tech department. You will own the architecture and performance of the machine learning pipeline that powers Stickerbox, scaling this technology to support a global product launch. This role is designed for a builder who wants to learn exactly how to launch and scale a physical AI product for kids from the ground up. You will make the foundational architectural decisions and translate product requirements into reality. This is a hybrid role, 3 days per week out of our Long Island City office. **How will you create impact?** * Own end\-to\-end latency from a kid's voiced input to a physical printed sticker, and the profiling to eliminate every bottleneck * Design and manage model deployment, versioning, and rollback strategies for a fleet of consumer hardware devices * Optimize batching, caching, and GPU utilization across image generation, speech recognition, and character models to keep the experience fast and affordable * Conduct build\-vs\-buy analysis for hosting and inference architecture and lead any resulting migrations * Design and maintain serving\-side enforcement of product safety, kid\-safe compliance, and automated character\-fidelity checks * Manage the queues, autoscaling, observability, and release engineering that supports the ML generation path **What are your skills and experience?** * Experience deploying and operating diffusion or similar generative ML models in production with real latency constraints * Experience profiling a generation path to optimize for performance and cost * End\-to\-end production ownership experience, including deployment, capacity planning, observability, and on\-call support * Advanced knowledge of ML infrastructure, inference systems, and production software architecture * Experience translating product requirements into scalable technical solutions and roadmaps * Experience with consumer hardware, on\-device/edge inference, ASR, or child\-directed digital products is a strong plus \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-HM1 *The anticipated pay range for candidates who will work in New York City is $166,100 to $221,400 Per Annum. The offered pay to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience within the job, years of experience within the required industry, education, etc. Spin Master Inc. is a multi\-state employer, and this salary range may not reflect positions that work only in other states.* This job posting is tied to an open vacancy. **What you can expect from us:** Our mission is to Make Life More Fun with a vision to push the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and fun. * Growth and Career Opportunities * Flexible Work Hours * Innovation, Collaboration and Fun * Comprehensive Benefits * Other fun Perks! **What’s it like to work here?** Spin Master is a fast\-paced, hands\-on organization that provides many great opportunities for impactful decision\-making; though our challenging start\-up atmosphere isn’t for everyone, we have a proven record of opportunities for future advancement and internal transfers for our passionate and results driven team. Everyone is welcome in our sandbox and we are committed to an accessible and inclusive hiring process that provides reasonable accommodation to all applicants. Spin Master strives to create an accessible and inclusive application and selection process and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to job applicants who may require provisions to participate in the recruitment, selection and/or assessment processes. Should you require an accommodation, please contact our Talent Acquisition team, by email at TAinquiries@spinmaster.com or by phone at 416 364\-6002 and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. ***Follow us on Instagram and Twitter @SpinMaster to stay up to date on Spin Master career opportunities.*** *We do appreciate all interest; however only those selected for interview will be contacted.*

jobs.description: Engineering Machine Learning Permanent New York The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most\-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. Surfaces Moments is a ML team within the Personalization Mission focused on creating moment\-based experiences across Spotify surfaces. The team owns and evolves the experiences that help listeners quickly connect with the content that matters most to them, including the Home Shortcuts experience and the underlying intelligence that powers it. By combining cutting\-edge machine learning, recommendation systems, and product thinking, the team delivers highly relevant, personalized experiences to millions of listeners around the world. As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will help shape the future of personalized discovery and engagement at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production\-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences that delight users and drive meaningful impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking models from research to production, driving technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces, and solving complex personalization challenges at global scale. What You'll Do * + Own and improve the machine learning models and systems that power the Home feed, including the Shortcuts experience. + Design, build, and ship personalized recommendations that serve millions of Spotify listeners globally. + Build content recommendation systems for emerging agentic and AI\-powered user experiences. + Train, fine\-tune, evaluate, and optimize large language models using techniques such as supervised fine\-tuning (SFT), distillation, and parameter\-efficient training approaches. + Partner closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to define and execute experimentation strategies. + Drive A/B testing, monitoring, model evaluation, and continuous optimization of recommendation quality, reliability, and cost efficiency. + Improve ML platform capabilities, data pipelines, and production systems that support personalization at Spotify scale. + Drive technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces and contribute to the long\-term architecture of personalization systems. + Mentor and support other machine learning engineers, helping raise the bar across the team. Who You Are * + You have 8\+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments. + You have deep expertise in recommendation systems, ranking models, personalization, or large\-scale content discovery platforms. + You have strong proficiency in Python and hands\-on experience building machine learning systems with PyTorch. + You are experienced with large language model training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, and optimization techniques including SFT, distillation, and LoRA. + You have worked with large\-scale inference systems and understand the challenges of latency, reliability, and cost optimization. + You care deeply about creating high\-quality user experiences through thoughtful application of machine learning. + You communicate effectively across technical and non\-technical audiences, and you influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team + You know how to design, execute, and interpret online experiments and A/B tests to improve user outcomes. + You have experience operating distributed machine learning workloads using technologies such as Ray, FSDP, HSDP, or similar frameworks. + You are experienced building and maintaining data pipelines and orchestration workflows using technologies such as Flyte, Airflow, BigQuery, and cloud\-based storage platforms. Where You'll Be * + We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location. + This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration. Learn about life at Spotify The United States base range for this position is $227,495\- $324,993 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future. Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward\-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know \- we’re here to support you in any way we can. Our global benefits Extensive learning opportunities, through our dedicated team, GreenHouse. Flexible share incentives letting you choose how you share in our success. Global parental leave, six months off \- for all new parents. All The Feels, our employee assistance program and self\-care hub. Flexible public holidays, swap days off according to your values and beliefs.

**Cloud\-Native Infrastructure \& Workload Enablement** * Partner with application teams to onboard and modernize workloads into containerized, cloud\-native architectures * Enable scalable, resilient observability tools Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry * Experience influencing or owning platform/product roadmaps in partnership with Product Management. * Solid background in cloud native engineering concepts, performance optimization, security, and governance. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field **Soft Skills \& Leadership Capabilities** * Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership and client levels. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate across engineering, product, architecture, and business teams. * Emphasizes ownership, platform standards, and cross\-team collaboration * Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving alignment across multiple stakeholders. * Proven ability to mentor, coach, and inspire high\-performing technical teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Financial Services industry experience is strongly preferred. * Experience supporting regulated environments with strong data security, compliance, and governance requirements. * Prior experience in customer\-facing or consulting roles is a plus. **What Success Looks Like** * A clearly defined and well\-executed Cloud Native adoption roadmap aligned to business and product priorities. * Increased adoption and effective use of cloud native capabilities across engineering and client solutions. * Strong partnerships with Product, Architecture, and Client teams, resulting in scalable, future\-ready data solutions. * Recognition as a trusted technology and platform leader within the
